  it('measures five waves of twenty independent quota-scoped template intents', async () => {
    const submissions = app.get(TemplateSubmissionService);
    const drafts = app.get(TemplateDraftService);
    const intents: Array<{ actorId: string; buId: string; draftId: string; fingerprint: string; key: string; name: string }> = [];
    const targets: string[] = [];
    for (let index = 0; index < 100; index += 1) {
      const tenant = await criarMantenedora(app, `Template PCV ${index}`, `template-pcv-${Date.now()}-${index}@example.test`);
      const createdChannel = await criarCanalVerificado(prisma, tenant.businessUnit.id, 'OFICIAL', `template-pcv-phone-${Date.now()}-${index}`);
      const target = `waba-pcv-${index}`;
      targets.push(target);
      await prisma.buChannel.update({ where: { id: createdChannel.channel.id }, data: {
        wabaId: target, status: 'DESCONECTADO', receiptVerifiedAt: null,
      } });
      const definition = { name: `pcv_template_${String(index).padStart(3, '0')}`, language: 'pt_BR' as const,
        category: 'UTILITY' as const, body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } };
      const draft = await drafts.createDraft(tenant.owner.id, { buId: tenant.businessUnit.id,
        channelId: createdChannel.channel.id, expectedGeneration: 1,
        clientRequestId: `template-pcv-${index}`, definition });
      intents.push({ actorId: tenant.owner.id, buId: tenant.businessUnit.id, draftId: draft.id,
        fingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint, key: `00000000-0000-4000-8000-${String(index + 1).padStart(12, '0')}`,
        name: definition.name });
    }

    let grantCalls = 0;
    let preflightCalls = 0;
    let postCalls = 0;
    const postPayloads: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
    const accountReferences = new Set<string>();
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input); const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      if (url.includes('/debug_token') && method === 'GET') {
        grantCalls += 1;
        return response(200, { data: { app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true,
          scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'],
          granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: targets }] } });
      }
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') { preflightCalls += 1; return response(200, { data: [] }); }
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') {
        postCalls += 1;
        const payload = JSON.parse(String(init.body)) as Record<string, unknown>;
        postPayloads.push(payload);
        return response(200, { id: `template-pcv-remote-${String(payload.name)}` });
      }
      throw new Error(`unexpected PCV request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    const waveDurationsMs: number[] = [];
    try {
      for (let wave = 0; wave < 5; wave += 1) {
        const waveStartedAt = performance.now();
        const waveIntents = intents.slice(wave * 20, (wave + 1) * 20);
        const waveResults = await Promise.allSettled(waveIntents.map((intent) =>
          submissions.submitDraft(intent.actorId, { draftId: intent.draftId, expectedRevision: 1,
            expectedGeneration: 1, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: intent.fingerprint, idempotencyKey: intent.key })));
        expect(waveResults.every((result) => result.status === 'fulfilled')).toBe(true);
        const outcomes = waveResults.map((result) => {
          if (result.status === 'rejected') throw result.reason;
          return result.value;
        });
        expect(outcomes).toHaveLength(20);
        expect(outcomes.every((outcome) => outcome.phase === 'ACCEPTED')).toBe(true);
        waveDurationsMs.push(Number((performance.now() - waveStartedAt).toFixed(2)));
        const persisted = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findMany({ where: { draftId: { in: waveIntents.map((item) => item.draftId) } },
          select: { id: true, draftId: true, buId: true, actorUserId: true, accountReference: true, phase: true, remoteTemplateId: true } });
        expect(persisted).toHaveLength(20);
        expect(new Set(persisted.map((row) => row.accountReference)).size).toBe(20);
        persisted.forEach((row) => accountReferences.add(row.accountReference));
        const operationIds = outcomes.map((outcome) => outcome.id);
        const receipts = await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.findMany({ where: { operationId: { in: operationIds } },
          orderBy: [{ operationId: 'asc' }, { sequence: 'asc' }],
          select: { operationId: true, phase: true } });
        const reservations = await prisma.messageTemplateNameReservation.findMany({ where: { operationId: { in: operationIds } },
          select: { operationId: true } });
        for (let offset = 0; offset < waveIntents.length; offset += 1) {
          const intent = waveIntents[offset];
          const operation = persisted.find((row) => row.id === outcomes[offset].id);
          expect(operation).toMatchObject({ draftId: intent.draftId, buId: intent.buId,
            actorUserId: intent.actorId, phase: 'ACCEPTED', remoteTemplateId: `template-pcv-remote-${intent.name}` });
          expect(receipts.filter((row) => row.operationId === outcomes[offset].id).map((row) => row.phase))
            .toEqual(['PREPARED', 'SENDING', 'ACCEPTED']);
          expect(reservations.filter((row) => row.operationId === outcomes[offset].id)).toHaveLength(1);
        }
      }
      const elapsedMs = Number(waveDurationsMs.reduce((sum, duration) => sum + duration, 0).toFixed(2));
      const indexPlan = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ 'QUERY PLAN': unknown }>>`
        EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON)
        SELECT id FROM message_template_operations
        WHERE bu_id = ${intents[0].buId} AND actor_user_id = ${intents[0].actorId}
          AND idempotency_key = ${intents[0].key}::uuid
      `;
      const uniqueIndex = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ indexdef: string }>>`
        SELECT indexdef FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = current_schema()
          AND indexname = 'mt_ops_bu_actor_key_uq'
      `;
      const storage = await prisma.$queryRaw<Array<{ relationBytes: bigint; totalBytes: bigint }>>`
        SELECT pg_relation_size('message_template_operations') AS "relationBytes",
          pg_total_relation_size('message_template_operations') AS "totalBytes"
      `;
      const evidence = { evidenceType: 'disposable-postgresql-template-intent-contention', waves: 5,
        intentsPerWave: 20, intentCount: intents.length, distinctActors: new Set(intents.map((item) => item.actorId)).size,
        distinctBusinessUnits: new Set(intents.map((item) => item.buId)).size,
        distinctAccounts: accountReferences.size,
        quotaPolicy: 'one actor and one account per intent; no quota bypass',
        providerCalls: { grants: grantCalls, preflightGets: preflightCalls, createPosts: postCalls },
        indexedLookup: indexPlan[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'], operationStorageBytes: {
          relation: Number(storage[0]?.relationBytes ?? 0), total: Number(storage[0]?.totalBytes ?? 0),
        }, writeCounts: { operations: await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.count(),
          receipts: await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.count(), reservations: await prisma.messageTemplateNameReservation.count() },
        waveDurationsMs, elapsedMs, intentsPerSecond: Number((intents.length / (elapsedMs / 1000)).toFixed(2)),
        limit: 'Bounded disposable fixture measurement; not a production capacity or latency claim.' };
      console.log(`[MESSAGE-TEMPLATE-PCV]${JSON.stringify(evidence)}`);
      expect(evidence).toMatchObject({ intentCount: 100, distinctActors: 100, distinctBusinessUnits: 100,
        distinctAccounts: 100, providerCalls: { grants: 100, preflightGets: 100, createPosts: 100 } });
      const payloadByName = new Map(postPayloads.map((payload) => [payload.name, payload]));
      expect(payloadByName.size).toBe(100);
      for (const intent of intents) {
        expect(payloadByName.get(intent.name)).toEqual({ name: intent.name, language: 'pt_BR', category: 'UTILITY',
          parameter_format: 'NAMED', components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: 'Olá {{first_name}}.',
            example: { body_text_named_params: [{ param_name: 'first_name', example: 'Ana' }] } }] });
      }

      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.count()).toBe(300);
      const lookupDocument = indexPlan[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] as Array<{ Plan?: Record<string, unknown> }> | undefined;
      const lookupNode = lookupDocument?.[0]?.Plan;
      expect(lookupNode?.['Node Type']).toMatch(/Index Scan/);
      expect(Number(lookupNode?.['Actual Rows'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
      expect(lookupNode?.['Actual Loops']).toBe(1);
      expect(lookupNode?.['Rows Removed by Filter'] ?? 0).toBe(0);
      expect(Number(lookupNode?.['Shared Hit Blocks'] ?? 0) + Number(lookupNode?.['Shared Read Blocks'] ?? 0)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(8);
      expect(uniqueIndex[0]?.indexdef).toMatch(/UNIQUE INDEX.*\(bu_id, actor_user_id, idempotency_key\)/i);
    } finally { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }
  });

      const visit = (node: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): void => {
        if (!node) return;
        nodes.push(node);
        for (const child of (node['Plans'] as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined) ?? []) visit(child);
      };
      visit(root);
      const operation = nodes.find((node) => node['Relation Name'] === 'message_template_operations');
      return operation ? Number(operation['Actual Loops'] ?? 0) : null;
    };
    const pageLimit = (plan: typeof draftPlan): { rows: number; loops: number } | null => {
      const root = (plan[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] as Array<{ Plan?: Record<string, unknown> }> | undefined)?.[0]?.Plan;
      const nodes: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
      const visit = (node: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): void => {
        if (!node) return;
        nodes.push(node);
        for (const child of (node['Plans'] as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined) ?? []) visit(child);
      };
      visit(root);
      const pageCte = nodes.find((node) => node['Subplan Name'] === 'CTE page_drafts');
      return pageCte?.['Node Type'] === 'Limit'
        ? { rows: Number(pageCte['Actual Rows'] ?? Number.NaN), loops: Number(pageCte['Actual Loops'] ?? Number.NaN) }
        : null;

        parentCountQueries: events.filter((event) => /COUNT\s*\(/i.test(event.query) && event.query.includes('message_template_drafts')).length,

    });

        queryPlan: detailPlan[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'], directOperationReceiptQueries: operationDetailEvents

        directOperationReceiptSequences: operationDetail.receipts.map((receipt) => receipt.sequence) },

      relationBytes: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(sizes[0] ?? {}).map(([key, value]) => [key, Number(value)])),
      indexBytes: indexSizes.map((row) => ({ name: row.indexName, bytes: Number(row.bytes) })),
      fixtureWrites: { drafts: 1000, revisions: 1000, operations: 1014, receipts: 10000,
        reservations: 1000, observationLeases: 1, observations: 1000, cataloguePages: 1 },
      limit: 'Synthetic row cardinality and real PostgreSQL query plans on disposable DB; not a production capacity claim.' };

    expect(evidence.list).toMatchObject({ page20Items: 20, page50Items: 50 });
    expect(evidence.list.pageScenarios.map((scenario) => [scenario.label, scenario.returnedRows, scenario.total])).toEqual([
      ['first20', 20, 1000], ['first50', 50, 1000], ['deep', 20, 1000], ['last', 20, 1000], ['beyond', 0, 1000],
    ]);
    for (const scenario of evidence.list.pageScenarios) {
      expect(scenario.rowQueryCount).toBe(1);
      expect(scenario.parentCountQueries).toBe(1);
      expect(scenario.pageLimit).toEqual({ rows: scenario.returnedRows, loops: 1 });
      expect(scenario.operationLookupLoops).not.toBeNull();
      expect(scenario.operationLookupLoops!).toBeLessThanOrEqual(scenario.returnedRows);
    }
    expect(evidence.list.relatedQueries).toHaveLength(2);
    for (const query of evidence.list.relatedQueries as string[]) {
      expect(query).toMatch(/LEFT JOIN LATERAL/i);
      expect(query).toMatch(/ORDER BY op\.revision DESC LIMIT 1/i);
      expect(query).toMatch(/page_drafts AS MATERIALIZED/i);
      expect(query).toMatch(/ORDER BY d\.created_at DESC, d\.id DESC\s+LIMIT \$\d+ OFFSET \$\d+[\s\S]*LEFT JOIN LATERAL/i);
    }
    expect(evidence.detail.recentOperations).toBe(11);
    expect(evidence.detail.receiptCounts).toHaveLength(11);
    expect(evidence.detail.receiptCounts.every((count) => count === 10)).toBe(true);
    expect(evidence.detail.operationQueries).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(evidence.detail.operationQueries[0]).toMatch(/LEFT JOIN LATERAL/i);
    expect(evidence.detail.operationQueries[0]).toMatch(/ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 11/i);
    expect(evidence.detail.operationQueries[0]).toMatch(/ORDER BY sequence DESC LIMIT 10/i);
    expect(evidence.detail.receiptQueries).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(evidence.detail.directOperationReceiptQueries).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(evidence.detail.directOperationReceiptQueries[0]).toMatch(/ORDER BY .*sequence.*DESC.*LIMIT/i);
    expect(evidence.detail.directOperationReceiptSequences).toEqual(Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => 500 - index));
    expect(evidence.catalogue.items).toBe(50);
    const draftPlanRoot = (draftPlan[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] as Array<{ Plan?: Record<string, unknown> }> | undefined)?.[0]?.Plan;
    const draftNodes: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];

      if (!node) return;
      draftNodes.push(node);
      for (const child of (node['Plans'] as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined) ?? []) collectPlanNodes(child);
    };
    collectPlanNodes(draftPlanRoot);
    const draftScan = draftNodes.find((node) => node['Relation Name'] === 'message_template_drafts');
    expect(draftScan?.['Node Type']).toMatch(/Index Scan/);
    expect(Number(draftScan?.['Rows Removed by Filter'] ?? 0)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(50);
    expect(Number(draftScan?.['Shared Hit Blocks'] ?? 0) + Number(draftScan?.['Shared Read Blocks'] ?? 0)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(12);
    const operationScan = draftNodes.find((node) => node['Relation Name'] === 'message_template_operations');
    expect(operationScan?.['Index Name']).toBe('mt_ops_draft_revision_uq');
    expect(Number(operationScan?.['Actual Rows'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(Number(operationScan?.['Actual Loops'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(50);
    const catalogPlanText = JSON.stringify(catalogPlan[0]?.['QUERY PLAN']);
    expect(catalogPlanText).toContain('mt_observation_context_remote_uq');
    expect(catalogPlanText).not.toContain('Seq Scan');
    const catalogPlanRoot = (catalogPlan[0]?.['QUERY PLAN'] as Array<{ Plan?: Record<string, unknown> }> | undefined)?.[0]?.Plan;
    const catalogNodes: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
    const collectCatalogPlanNodes = (node: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): void => {
      if (!node) return;
      catalogNodes.push(node);
      for (const child of (node['Plans'] as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined) ?? []) collectCatalogPlanNodes(child);
    };
    collectCatalogPlanNodes(catalogPlanRoot);
    const requestedScan = catalogNodes.find((node) => node['Function Name'] === 'unnest');
    const observationScan = catalogNodes.find((node) => node['Relation Name'] === 'message_template_remote_observations');
    expect(requestedScan?.['Node Type']).toBe('Function Scan');
    expect(Number(requestedScan?.['Actual Loops'] ?? 0)).toBe(1);
    expect(Number(requestedScan?.['Actual Rows'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBe(50);
    expect(observationScan?.['Index Name']).toBe('mt_observation_context_remote_uq');
    expect(observationScan?.['Node Type']).toMatch(/Index Scan/);
    expect(Number(observationScan?.['Actual Loops'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(50);
    expect(Number(observationScan?.['Actual Rows'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(1);
    expect(Number(observationScan?.['Rows Removed by Filter'] ?? 0)).toBe(0);
    expect(Number(observationScan?.['Shared Hit Blocks'] ?? 0) + Number(observationScan?.['Shared Read Blocks'] ?? 0)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(150);
    const detailPlanNodes: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
    const collectDetailPlanNodes = (node: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): void => {
      if (!node) return;
      detailPlanNodes.push(node);
      for (const child of (node['Plans'] as Array<Record<string, unknown>> | undefined) ?? []) collectDetailPlanNodes(child);
    };
    collectDetailPlanNodes((evidence.detail.queryPlan as Array<{ Plan?: Record<string, unknown> }> | undefined)?.[0]?.Plan);
    const operationDetailScan = detailPlanNodes.find((node) => node['Relation Name'] === 'message_template_operations');
    const receiptDetailScan = detailPlanNodes.find((node) => node['Relation Name'] === 'message_template_submission_receipts');
    expect(operationDetailScan?.['Index Name']).toBe('mt_ops_draft_revision_uq');
    expect(Number(operationDetailScan?.['Actual Rows'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(11);
    expect(Number(operationDetailScan?.['Actual Loops'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBe(1);
    expect(receiptDetailScan?.['Node Type']).toMatch(/Index Scan/);
    expect(Number(receiptDetailScan?.['Actual Rows'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(10);
    expect(Number(receiptDetailScan?.['Actual Loops'] ?? Number.POSITIVE_INFINITY)).toBeLessThanOrEqual(11);
    expect(Number(receiptDetailScan?.['Rows Removed by Filter'] ?? 0)).toBe(0);
  });

  it.each([
    { label: 'same identifier', candidateId: 'late-ack-authoritative' },
    { label: 'different identifier', candidateId: 'different-get-candidate' },
  ])('lets a known dispatch ACK win over a held recovery GET lease ($label)', async ({ candidateId }) => {
    const drafts = app.get(TemplateDraftService);
    const submissions = app.get(TemplateSubmissionService);
    const definition = { name: 'late_ack_wins', language: 'pt_BR' as const, category: 'UTILITY' as const, body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } };
    const draft = await drafts.createDraft(ownerId, { buId, channelId: channel1, expectedGeneration: 1, clientRequestId: 'late-ack-wins', definition });
    const postStarted = deferred<void>();
    const postHold = deferred<Response>();
    const recoveryListStarted = deferred<void>();
    const recoveryListHold = deferred<Response>();
    let submitPromise: ReturnType<TemplateSubmissionService['submitDraft']> | undefined;
    let reconciliation: ReturnType<TemplateSubmissionService['reconcile']> | undefined;
    let listCalls = 0;
    const calls: Array<{ url: string; method: string }> = [];
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input);
      const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      calls.push({ url, method });
      if (url.includes('/debug_token') && method === 'GET') return response(200, { data: {
        app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true, scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'],
        granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: ['waba-a'] }],
      } });
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') {
        listCalls += 1;
        if (listCalls === 1) return response(200, { data: [] });
        recoveryListStarted.resolve();
        return recoveryListHold.promise;
      }
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') {
        postStarted.resolve();
        return postHold.promise;
      }
      throw new Error(`unexpected template request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    try {
      const input = { draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: 1,
        expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint, idempotencyKey: '1d672ddf-0783-46c4-8be4-3d46f6a09672' };
      submitPromise = submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, input);
      await postStarted.promise;
      const operation = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { draftId: draft.id, actorUserId: ownerId } });
      await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.update({ where: { id: operation.id }, data: { leaseUntil: new Date(0) } });
      const expired = await submissions.reconcile(ownerId, draft.id, operation.id);
      expect(expired).toMatchObject({ phase: 'AMBIGUOUS' });
      reconciliation = submissions.reconcile(ownerId, draft.id, operation.id);
      await recoveryListStarted.promise;
      const leased = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: operation.id } });
      expect(leased.recoveryOwnerId).toBeTruthy();
      expect(leased.recoveryLeaseUntil?.getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now());

      postHold.resolve(response(200, { id: 'late-ack-authoritative' }));
      const acknowledged = await submitPromise;
      expect(acknowledged).toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED', remoteTemplateId: 'late-ack-authoritative' });
      recoveryListHold.resolve(response(200, { data: [{ id: candidateId, name: 'late_ack_wins',
        language: 'pt_BR', status: 'PENDING', category: 'UTILITY', parameter_format: 'NAMED',
        components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: 'Olá {{first_name}}.' }] }] }));
      await expect(reconciliation).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'TEMPLATE_RECONCILIATION_SUPERSEDED' } });
      const final = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: operation.id }, select: {
        phase: true, remoteTemplateId: true, acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId: true, acceptanceProvenance: true, leaseOwnerId: true,
      } });
      expect(final).toEqual({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', remoteTemplateId: 'late-ack-authoritative',
        acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId: 'late-ack-authoritative', acceptanceProvenance: 'ACKNOWLEDGED', leaseOwnerId: operation.leaseOwnerId });
      expect(calls.filter(({ url, method }) => url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST')).toHaveLength(1);
    } finally {
      postHold.resolve(response(200, { id: 'late-ack-authoritative' }));
      recoveryListHold.resolve(response(200, { data: [] }));
      await Promise.allSettled([submitPromise, reconciliation].filter((promise): promise is Promise<unknown> => Boolean(promise)));
      vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    }
  });

  it.each([
    { label: 'same identifier', providerId: 'correlated-template', expectedCode: null, fault: 'none' },
    { label: 'different identifier', providerId: 'provider-template-other', expectedCode: 'PROVIDER_ACK_CONFLICT', fault: 'none' },
    { label: 'rollback keeps correlation without ACK', providerId: 'correlated-template', expectedCode: null, fault: 'rollback' },
    { label: 'different identifier rollback keeps correlation without ACK', providerId: 'provider-template-other', expectedCode: 'PROVIDER_ACK_CONFLICT', fault: 'rollback' },
    { label: 'post-commit throw confirms exact receipt', providerId: 'correlated-template', expectedCode: null, fault: 'postcommit' },
    { label: 'different identifier post-commit throw confirms exact receipt', providerId: 'provider-template-other', expectedCode: 'PROVIDER_ACK_CONFLICT', fault: 'postcommit' },
    { label: 'post-commit readback unavailable stays unconfirmed', providerId: 'correlated-template', expectedCode: null, fault: 'unavailable' },
    { label: 'different identifier readback unavailable stays unconfirmed', providerId: 'provider-template-other', expectedCode: 'PROVIDER_ACK_CONFLICT', fault: 'unavailable' },
  ])('records a provider ACK after a correlated recovery and preserves the association ($label)', async ({ providerId, expectedCode, fault }) => {
    const drafts = app.get(TemplateDraftService);
    const submissions = app.get(TemplateSubmissionService);
    const definition = { name: `correlated_ack_${providerId.replaceAll('-', '_')}`, language: 'pt_BR' as const,
      category: 'UTILITY' as const, body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } };
    const draft = await drafts.createDraft(ownerId, { buId, channelId: channel1, expectedGeneration: 1,
      clientRequestId: `correlated-ack-${providerId}`, definition });
    const postStarted = deferred<void>();
    const postHold = deferred<Response>();
    const listStarted = deferred<void>();
    const listHold = deferred<Response>();
    let submitPromise: ReturnType<TemplateSubmissionService['submitDraft']> | undefined;
    let reconciliation: ReturnType<TemplateSubmissionService['reconcile']> | undefined;
    let faultArmed = false;
    const boundary = app.get<TemplateTransactionBoundary>(TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY);
    const originalRun = boundary.run.bind(boundary);
    if (fault !== 'none') vi.spyOn(boundary, 'run').mockImplementation(async (phase, work) => {
      if (!faultArmed || phase !== 'record-outcome') return originalRun(phase, work);
      if (fault === 'rollback') return originalRun(phase, async (tx) => {
        await work(tx);
        throw new Error('injected ACK transaction rollback after writes');
      });
      const result = await originalRun(phase, work);
      if (fault === 'postcommit' || fault === 'unavailable') throw new Error('injected ACK post-commit boundary failure');
      return result;
    });
    let listCalls = 0;
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input);
      const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      if (url.includes('/debug_token') && method === 'GET') return response(200, { data: {
        app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true, scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'],
        granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: ['waba-a'] }],
      } });
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') {
        listCalls += 1;
        if (listCalls === 1) return response(200, { data: [] });
        listStarted.resolve();
        return listHold.promise;
      }
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') {
        postStarted.resolve();
        return postHold.promise;
      }
      throw new Error(`unexpected template request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    try {
      submitPromise = submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, { draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 1,
        expectedGeneration: 1, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint,
        idempotencyKey: providerId === 'correlated-template'
          ? 'c1a9dff3-9762-4d5b-8a0e-5df80a2f5b17' : '27dc070c-2445-4cbc-a11f-6085be6f57c9' });
      await postStarted.promise;
      const operation = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { draftId: draft.id, actorUserId: ownerId } });
      await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.update({ where: { id: operation.id }, data: { leaseUntil: new Date(0) } });
      expect(await submissions.reconcile(ownerId, draft.id, operation.id)).toMatchObject({ phase: 'AMBIGUOUS' });
      reconciliation = submissions.reconcile(ownerId, draft.id, operation.id);
      await listStarted.promise;
      listHold.resolve(response(200, { data: [{ id: 'correlated-template', name: definition.name,
        language: 'pt_BR', status: 'PENDING', category: 'UTILITY', parameter_format: 'NAMED',
        components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: 'Olá {{first_name}}.' }] }] }));
      await expect(reconciliation).resolves.toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED',
        remoteTemplateId: 'correlated-template', providerAcceptance: 'UNKNOWN' });
      faultArmed = true;
      postHold.resolve(response(200, { id: providerId }));
      let acknowledged: Awaited<NonNullable<typeof submitPromise>>;
      if (fault === 'rollback') {
        await expect(submitPromise).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 503, response: {
          providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED', receiptPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED',
        } });
        acknowledged = await submissions.getOperation(ownerId, draft.id,
          (await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { draftId: draft.id } })).id) as Awaited<NonNullable<typeof submitPromise>>;
        expect(acknowledged).toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', providerAcceptance: 'UNKNOWN',
          remoteTemplateId: 'correlated-template', acceptanceProvenance: 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION' });
      } else if (fault === 'unavailable') {
        await expect(withReadbackFailure(submissions, 'messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt', 'findFirst',
          () => submitPromise!)).rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 503, response: {
          providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED', receiptPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED',
        } });
        acknowledged = await submissions.getOperation(ownerId, draft.id,
          (await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { draftId: draft.id } })).id) as Awaited<NonNullable<typeof submitPromise>>;
      } else {
        acknowledged = await submitPromise!;
      }
      if (fault === 'rollback') {
        const rolledBack = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { draftId: draft.id } });
        expect(rolledBack).toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', remoteTemplateId: 'correlated-template',
          acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId: null, acceptanceProvenance: 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION' });
        expect(await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.count({ where: { operationId: rolledBack.id } })).toBe(4);
        return;
      }
      expect(acknowledged).toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED',
        remoteTemplateId: 'correlated-template', safeCode: expectedCode,
        acceptanceProvenance: expectedCode ? 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION' : 'ACKNOWLEDGED' });
      const final = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: operation.id }, select: {
        phase: true, remoteTemplateId: true, acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId: true, acceptanceProvenance: true, safeCode: true,
        leaseOwnerId: true,
      } });
      expect(final).toEqual({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', remoteTemplateId: 'correlated-template',
        acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId: providerId,
        acceptanceProvenance: expectedCode ? 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION' : 'ACKNOWLEDGED', safeCode: expectedCode,
        leaseOwnerId: operation.leaseOwnerId });
      faultArmed = false;
      const receiptCountBeforeReplay = await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.count({ where: { operationId: operation.id } });
      const storedDraft = await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: draft.id } });
      const capturedContext = await app.get<TemplateManagementResolver>(TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT_RESOLVER)
        .resolve({ buId, channelId: channel1, expectedGeneration: operation.channelGeneration });
      const recordAckAgain = Reflect.get(submissions, 'recordAcknowledgedOutcome') as (...args: unknown[]) => Promise<void>;
      await Reflect.apply(recordAckAgain, submissions, [operation.id, operation.leaseOwnerId!, operation.dispatchClaimId!,
        ownerId, storedDraft, operation.requestHash, capturedContext.context, providerId]);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.count({ where: { operationId: operation.id } }))
        .toBe(receiptCountBeforeReplay);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: operation.id } }))
        .toMatchObject({ remoteTemplateId: 'correlated-template', acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId: providerId,
          acceptanceProvenance: expectedCode ? 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION' : 'ACKNOWLEDGED', safeCode: expectedCode });
    } finally {
      postHold.resolve(response(200, { id: providerId }));
      listHold.resolve(response(200, { data: [] }));
      await Promise.allSettled([submitPromise, reconciliation].filter((promise): promise is Promise<unknown> => Boolean(promise)));
      vi.restoreAllMocks();
      vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    }
  });

  it('projects durable ACK authority when its receipt is outside the bounded recent window', async () => {
    const drafts = app.get(TemplateDraftService);
    const submissions = app.get(TemplateSubmissionService);
    const definition = { name: 'ack_outside_recent_window', language: 'pt_BR' as const,
      category: 'UTILITY' as const, body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } };
    const draft = await drafts.createDraft(ownerId, { buId, channelId: channel1, expectedGeneration: 1,
      clientRequestId: 'ack-outside-recent-window', definition });
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input); const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      if (url.includes('/debug_token') && method === 'GET') return response(200, { data: {
        app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true, scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'],
        granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: ['waba-a'] }],
      } });
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') return response(200, { data: [] });
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') return response(200, { id: 'durable-ack-remote' });
      throw new Error(`unexpected template request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    try {
      const input = { draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: 1,
        expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint, idempotencyKey: '45da8567-1a84-4816-927f-752f9d848dc9' };
      const accepted = await submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, input);
      const operationId = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { draftId: draft.id }, select: { id: true } });
      await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.createMany({ data: Array.from({ length: 10 }, (_, index) => ({
        operationId: operationId.id, sequence: index + 4, phase: 'ACCEPTED' as const,
        safeCode: `later-${index}`, remoteTemplateId: 'durable-ack-remote', acceptanceProvenance: 'ACKNOWLEDGED' as const,
      })) });
      expect(accepted.receipts.some((receipt) => receipt.acceptanceProvenance === 'ACKNOWLEDGED')).toBe(true);
      const direct = await submissions.getOperation(ownerId, draft.id, operationId.id);
      const detail = await drafts.getDraft(ownerId, buId, draft.id);
      const replay = await submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, input);
      const reconciled = await submissions.reconcile(ownerId, draft.id, operationId.id);
      for (const projection of [direct, detail.currentOperation, replay, reconciled]) {
        expect(projection).toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED',
          acceptanceProvenance: 'ACKNOWLEDGED', remoteTemplateId: 'durable-ack-remote' });
      }
      expect(direct.receipts.some((receipt) => receipt.sequence === 3)).toBe(false);
      expect(detail.currentOperation).not.toHaveProperty('receipts');
      await expect(prisma.messageTemplateOperation.update({ where: { id: operationId.id }, data: {
        acknowledgedRemoteTemplateId: 'replacement-ack',
      } })).rejects.toThrow();
      await expect(prisma.messageTemplateOperation.update({ where: { id: operationId.id }, data: {
        acceptanceProvenance: 'CORRELATED_BY_DEFINITION',
      } })).rejects.toThrow();
      await expect(prisma.messageTemplateOperation.update({ where: { id: operationId.id }, data: {
        remoteTemplateId: 'replacement-association',
      } })).rejects.toThrow();
      const ackReceipt = await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.findFirstOrThrow({ where: {
        operationId: operationId.id, sequence: 3,
      }, select: { id: true } });
      await expect(prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.update({ where: { id: ackReceipt.id }, data: {
        safeCode: 'rewritten',
      } })).rejects.toThrow();
      await expect(prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.delete({ where: { id: ackReceipt.id } })).rejects.toThrow();
      const storedOperation = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: operationId.id } });
      const storedDraft = await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: draft.id } });
      const resolved = await app.get<TemplateManagementResolver>(TEMPLATE_MANAGEMENT_RESOLVER).resolve({
        buId, channelId: channel1, expectedGeneration: storedOperation.channelGeneration,
      });
      const recordAck = Reflect.get(submissions, 'recordAcknowledgedOutcome') as (...args: unknown[]) => Promise<void>;
      await expect(Reflect.apply(recordAck, submissions, [storedOperation.id, 'forged-owner', 'forged-claim',
        ownerId, storedDraft, storedOperation.requestHash, resolved.context, 'forged-ack']))
        .rejects.toMatchObject({ status: 503, response: { providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED', receiptPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED' } });
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: operationId.id } })).toEqual(storedOperation);
      expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(3);
    } finally { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }
  });

    let postCount = 0;
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input);
      const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      if (url.includes('/debug_token') && method === 'GET') return response(200, { data: {

      } });
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') return response(200, { data: [] });
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') {
        postCount += 1;
        if (postCount === 1) return response(400, { error: { type: 'OAuthException', message: 'private provider detail', code: 100 } });
        return response(200, { id: 'after-refusal' });
      }
      throw new Error(`unexpected template request ${method} ${url}`);

    try {

        expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint, idempotencyKey: '1b4c55f7-4af9-4925-9325-b2e30483d902',
      });
      expect(first.phase).toBe('REJECTED');
      expect(first.safeCode).toBe('PROVIDER_REFUSED');
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: first.id }, select: {
        phase: true, safeCode: true, dispatchClaimId: true, acceptanceProvenance: true,
      } })).toMatchObject({ phase: 'REJECTED', safeCode: 'PROVIDER_REFUSED', acceptanceProvenance: null });
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateSubmissionReceipt.findMany({ where: { operationId: first.id }, orderBy: { sequence: 'asc' }, select: {
        phase: true, safeCode: true,
      } })).toEqual([
        { phase: 'PREPARED', safeCode: 'RESERVED' },
        { phase: 'SENDING', safeCode: 'DISPATCH_CLAIMED' },
        { phase: 'REJECTED', safeCode: 'PROVIDER_REFUSED' },
      ]);
      expect(await prisma.messageTemplateNameReservation.count({ where: { operationId: first.id } })).toBe(0);
      expect((await prisma.messageTemplateDraft.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: draft.id } })).state).toBe('DRAFT');
      await expect(submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, {
        draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 1, expectedGeneration: 1,
        expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint, idempotencyKey: '677f31f4-82ca-4d83-a93d-874f113c5790',
      })).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'TEMPLATE_RECOVERY_REQUIRED', operationId: first.id } });
      const saved = await drafts.saveDraft(ownerId, { buId, draftId: draft.id, expectedGeneration: 1, expectedRevision: 1,
        definition: { ...definition, body: 'Atualizado {{first_name}}.' } });
      const second = await submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, {
        draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 2, expectedGeneration: 1,
        expectedDefinitionFingerprint: saved.definitionFingerprint!, idempotencyKey: '8b5ca1a9-47c5-405c-9f3c-4c9121c071a1',
      });
      expect(second).toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', remoteTemplateId: 'after-refusal' });
      expect(postCount).toBe(2);
    } finally { vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }
  });

  it('refreshes the operation for the greatest draft revision when timestamps disagree', async () => {
    const drafts = app.get(TemplateDraftService);
    const submissions = app.get(TemplateSubmissionService);
    const observations = app.get(TemplateObservationService);
    const boundary = app.get<TemplateTransactionBoundary>(TEMPLATE_TRANSACTION_BOUNDARY);
    const originalRun = boundary.run.bind(boundary);
    let operationInsertCount = 0;
    const boundarySpy = vi.spyOn(boundary, 'run').mockImplementation((phase, work) => originalRun(phase, (tx) => {
      if (phase !== 'reserve') return work(tx);
      const wrappedTx = new Proxy(tx, { get(target, property) {
        const delegate = Reflect.get(target, property, target);
        if (property !== 'messageTemplateOperation' || !delegate) return delegate;
        return new Proxy(delegate, { get(model, method) {
          const value = Reflect.get(model, method, model);
          if (method !== 'create') return typeof value === 'function' ? value.bind(model) : value;
          const create = value as (args: Prisma.MessageTemplateOperationCreateArgs) => Promise<unknown>;
          return (args: Prisma.MessageTemplateOperationCreateArgs) => {
            operationInsertCount += 1;
            const createdAt = new Date(Date.now() + (operationInsertCount === 1 ? 60_000 : 0));
            return create.call(model, { ...args, data: { ...args.data, createdAt } });
          };
        } });
      } });
      return work(wrappedTx);
    }));
    const firstDefinition = { name: 'revision_observation', language: 'pt_BR' as const,
      category: 'UTILITY' as const, body: 'Primeira revisão {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } };
    const draft = await drafts.createDraft(ownerId, { buId, channelId: channel1, expectedGeneration: 1,
      clientRequestId: 'revision-observation-current-op', definition: firstDefinition });
    let postCount = 0;
    const getIds: string[] = [];
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input); const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      if (url.includes('/debug_token')) return response(200, { data: { app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true,
        scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'], granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: ['waba-a'] }] } });
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') return response(200, { data: [] });
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') {
        postCount += 1;
        if (postCount === 1) return response(400, { error: { type: 'OAuthException', message: 'fixture refusal', code: 100 } });
        return response(200, { id: 'revision-current-remote' });
      }
      if (url.includes('/revision-current-remote?') && method === 'GET') {
        getIds.push('revision-current-remote');
        return response(200, { id: 'revision-current-remote', name: 'revision_observation', language: 'pt_BR',
          status: 'PENDING', category: 'UTILITY', parameter_format: 'NAMED',
          components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: 'Segunda revisão {{first_name}}.' }] });
      }
      throw new Error(`unexpected template request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    try {
      const refused = await submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, { draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 1,
        expectedGeneration: 1, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint,
        idempotencyKey: '2d4de58a-40cc-4fb7-aad8-b4906ce2a8bf' });
      expect(refused.phase).toBe('REJECTED');
      const secondDefinition = { ...firstDefinition, body: 'Segunda revisão {{first_name}}.' };
      const saved = await drafts.saveDraft(ownerId, { buId, draftId: draft.id, expectedGeneration: 1,
        expectedRevision: 1, definition: secondDefinition });
      expect(saved.revision).toBe(2);
      const accepted = await submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, { draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 2,
        expectedGeneration: 1, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: saved.definitionFingerprint,
        idempotencyKey: 'd14c5573-e2b2-4cc2-a83e-2662abddfa70' });
      expect(accepted).toMatchObject({ phase: 'ACCEPTED', revision: 2, remoteTemplateId: 'revision-current-remote' });
      expect(operationInsertCount).toBe(2);
      const storedOperations = await prisma.messageTemplateOperation.findMany({ where: { draftId: draft.id },
        orderBy: { revision: 'asc' }, select: { revision: true, phase: true, createdAt: true } });
      expect(storedOperations).toHaveLength(2);
      expect(storedOperations[0].createdAt.getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(storedOperations[1].createdAt.getTime());
      expect(storedOperations).toMatchObject([{ revision: 1, phase: 'REJECTED' }, { revision: 2, phase: 'ACCEPTED' }]);
      const refreshed = await observations.refreshDraft(ownerId, draft.id);
      expect(refreshed).toMatchObject({ remoteTemplateId: 'revision-current-remote', status: 'PENDING' });
      expect(getIds).toEqual(['revision-current-remote']);
    } finally { boundarySpy.mockRestore(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); }
  });

  it('shares one observation fence in both directions and rejects both late provider responses', async () => {
    const drafts = app.get(TemplateDraftService);
    const submissions = app.get(TemplateSubmissionService);
    const observations = app.get(TemplateObservationService);
    const clock = app.get<TemplateObservationClock>(TEMPLATE_OBSERVATION_CLOCK);
    let now = new Date();
    const clockSpy = vi.spyOn(clock, 'now').mockImplementation(() => new Date(now));
    const definition = { name: 'fenced_observation', language: 'pt_BR' as const, category: 'UTILITY' as const, body: 'Olá {{first_name}}.', examples: { first_name: 'Ana' } };
    const draft = await drafts.createDraft(ownerId, { buId, channelId: channel1, expectedGeneration: 1, clientRequestId: 'fenced-observation', definition });
    const catalogHold = deferred<Response>();
    const catalogStarted = deferred<void>();
    const getHold = deferred<Response>();
    const getStarted = deferred<void>();
    const nextGetHold = deferred<Response>();
    const nextGetStarted = deferred<void>();
    let oldCatalog: ReturnType<TemplateObservationService['refreshCatalog']> | undefined;
    let oldIndividual: ReturnType<TemplateObservationService['refreshDraft']> | undefined;
    let currentIndividual: ReturnType<TemplateObservationService['refreshDraft']> | undefined;
    const approved = { id: 'fenced-remote', name: definition.name, language: 'pt_BR', status: 'APPROVED', category: 'UTILITY', parameter_format: 'NAMED', components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: definition.body }] };
    const paused = { ...approved, status: 'PAUSED' };
    let catalogCalls = 0;
    let getCalls = 0;
    const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (input: RequestInfo | URL, init: RequestInit = {}) => {
      const url = String(input);
      const method = init.method ?? 'GET';
      if (url.includes('/debug_token')) return response(200, { data: {
        app_id: 'fixture-app', is_valid: true, scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'],
        granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: ['waba-a'] }],
      } });
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') {
        const parsed = new URL(url);
        if (parsed.searchParams.has('name')) return response(200, { data: [] });
        catalogCalls += 1;
        if (catalogCalls === 2) { catalogStarted.resolve(undefined); return catalogHold.promise; }
        return response(200, { data: [catalogCalls === 3 ? paused : approved] });
      }
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') return response(200, { id: 'fenced-remote' });
      if (url.includes('/fenced-remote?') && method === 'GET') {
        getCalls += 1;
        if (getCalls === 1) { getStarted.resolve(undefined); return getHold.promise; }
        if (getCalls === 2) { nextGetStarted.resolve(undefined); return nextGetHold.promise; }
        return response(200, paused);
      }
      throw new Error(`unexpected template request ${method} ${url}`);
    });
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    try {
      const submit = await submissions.submitDraft(ownerId, { draftId: draft.id, expectedRevision: 1,
        expectedGeneration: 1, expectedDefinitionFingerprint: draft.definitionFingerprint,
        idempotencyKey: '83dce83e-ff01-4f66-825b-f5f411f1d332' });
      expect(submit.phase).toBe('ACCEPTED');
      const firstCatalog = await observations.refreshCatalog(ownerId, buId, channel1, null);
      expect(firstCatalog).toMatchObject({ available: true, items: [{ status: 'APPROVED' }] });

      now = new Date(now.getTime() + 11_000);
      oldCatalog = observations.refreshCatalog(ownerId, buId, channel1, null);
      await catalogStarted.promise;
      now = new Date(now.getTime() + 61_000);
      currentIndividual = observations.refreshDraft(ownerId, draft.id);
      await getStarted.promise;
      const newLease = await prisma.messageTemplateObservationLease.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { channelId: channel1 },
        select: { ownerId: true, fence: true, leaseUntil: true, lastStartedAt: true } });
      expect(newLease.ownerId).toBeTruthy();
      catalogHold.resolve(response(200, { data: [approved] }));
      await expect(oldCatalog).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED' } });
      const heldLease = await prisma.messageTemplateObservationLease.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { channelId: channel1 },
        select: { ownerId: true, fence: true, leaseUntil: true, lastStartedAt: true } });
      expect(heldLease).toEqual(newLease);
      getHold.resolve(response(200, paused));
      expect(await currentIndividual).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAUSED', eligible: false });
      const releasedLease = await prisma.messageTemplateObservationLease.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { channelId: channel1 },
        select: { ownerId: true, fence: true, leaseUntil: true, lastStartedAt: true } });
      expect(releasedLease).toEqual({ ownerId: null, fence: newLease.fence, leaseUntil: null, lastStartedAt: newLease.lastStartedAt });
      const afterLateCatalog = await observations.getCatalog(ownerId, buId, channel1, null);
      expect(afterLateCatalog).toMatchObject({ available: true, items: [{ status: 'PAUSED', eligible: false }] });

      now = new Date(now.getTime() + 11_000);
      oldIndividual = observations.refreshDraft(ownerId, draft.id);
      await nextGetStarted.promise;
      now = new Date(now.getTime() + 61_000);
      const currentCatalog = await observations.refreshCatalog(ownerId, buId, channel1, null);
      expect(currentCatalog).toMatchObject({ available: true, items: [{ status: 'PAUSED', eligible: false }] });
      nextGetHold.resolve(response(200, approved));
      await expect(oldIndividual).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED' } });
      const afterLateIndividual = await observations.getCatalog(ownerId, buId, channel1, null);
      expect(afterLateIndividual.items[0]).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAUSED', eligible: false });
    } finally {
      catalogHold.resolve(response(200, { data: [approved] }));
      getHold.resolve(response(200, paused));
      nextGetHold.resolve(response(200, approved));
      await Promise.allSettled([oldCatalog, oldIndividual, currentIndividual].filter((promise): promise is Promise<unknown> => Boolean(promise)));
      clockSpy.mockRestore(); vi.unstubAllGlobals();
    }
  }, 20_000);

  it('does not let a late provider error mark unavailable or release a newer live observation lease', async () => {

    const individualHold = deferred<Response>(); const individualStarted = deferred<void>();

      parameter_format: 'NAMED', components: [{ type: 'BODY', text: definition.body }] };
    const paused = { ...approved, status: 'PAUSED' };

        scopes: ['whatsapp_business_management'], granular_scopes: [{ scope: 'whatsapp_business_management', target_ids: ['waba-a'] }] } });
      if (url.includes('/message_templates?') && method === 'GET') {
        const parsed = new URL(url); if (parsed.searchParams.has('name')) return response(200, { data: [] });
        catalogCalls += 1;
        if (catalogCalls === 2) { catalogStarted.resolve(undefined); return catalogHold.promise; }
        return response(200, { data: [approved] });
      }
      if (url.endsWith('/message_templates') && method === 'POST') return response(200, { id: approved.id });
      if (url.includes(`/${approved.id}?`) && method === 'GET') {

      }

    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock);
    try {

      await observations.refreshCatalog(ownerId, buId, channel1, null);

      oldCatalog = observations.refreshCatalog(ownerId, buId, channel1, null);
      await catalogStarted.promise;
      now = new Date(now.getTime() + 61_000);
      currentIndividual = observations.refreshDraft(ownerId, draft.id);
      await individualStarted.promise;

        select: { ownerId: true, fence: true, leaseUntil: true, lastStartedAt: true } });

      await expect(oldCatalog).rejects.toMatchObject({ response: { code: 'TEMPLATE_REFRESH_SUPERSEDED' } });
      const afterOldError = await prisma.messageTemplateObservationLease.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { channelId: channel1 },
        select: { ownerId: true, fence: true, leaseUntil: true, lastStartedAt: true } });
      expect(afterOldError).toEqual(liveLease);
      individualHold.resolve(response(200, paused));
      expect(await currentIndividual).toMatchObject({ status: 'PAUSED', available: true, eligible: false });
      const afterCurrentCommit = await prisma.messageTemplateObservationLease.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { channelId: channel1 },
        select: { ownerId: true, fence: true, leaseUntil: true, lastStartedAt: true } });

      expect(await observations.getCatalog(ownerId, buId, channel1, null)).toMatchObject({
        available: true, items: [{ status: 'PAUSED', eligible: false }],
      });
    } finally {
      catalogHold.resolve(response(503, { error: { message: 'fixture provider failure' } }));
      individualHold.resolve(response(200, paused));

async function seedNumberOnboarding() {
  const suffix = `number-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 8)}`;
  const createTenant = async (label) => {
    const mantenedora = await prisma.mantenedora.create({ data: { name: `${label} ${suffix}` } });
    const setor = await prisma.setor.create({ data: { mantenedoraId: mantenedora.id, name: 'Geral' } });
    const bu = await prisma.businessUnit.create({ data: { mantenedoraId: mantenedora.id, setorId: setor.id, name: `${label} BU`, phone: `5511${String(Date.now()).slice(-8)}` } });
    await prisma.mantenedoraSettings.create({ data: { mantenedoraId: mantenedora.id, onboardingConcluido: true, modulos: { canalNaoOficial: true } } });
    return { mantenedora, setor, bu };
  };
  const a = await createTenant('Onboarding A'); const b = await createTenant('Onboarding B');
  const createUser = async (tenant, role, label) => {
    const email = `${label}-${suffix}@teste.local`;
    const user = await prisma.appUser.create({ data: { mantenedoraId: tenant.mantenedora.id, name: label, email, passwordHash: await bcrypt.hash('senha-onboarding-2026', 10) } });
    await prisma.userBuRole.create({ data: {
      userId: user.id, buId: tenant.bu.id, role,
      grantedViaTipo: role === 'OWNER' ? 'MANTENEDORA' : 'DIRETO',
      ...(role === 'OWNER' ? { grantedViaId: tenant.mantenedora.id } : {}),
    } });
    return { id: user.id, email, password: 'senha-onboarding-2026', role };
  };
  return {
    tenantA: { mantenedoraId: a.mantenedora.id, buId: a.bu.id, owner: await createUser(a, 'OWNER', 'owner'), admin: await createUser(a, 'ADMIN', 'admin'), operator: await createUser(a, 'ATENDENTE', 'operator') },
    tenantB: { mantenedoraId: b.mantenedora.id, buId: b.bu.id, owner: await createUser(b, 'OWNER', 'other-owner'), admin: await createUser(b, 'ADMIN', 'other-admin') },
  };
}

async function incoming(data) {
  let profileName = 'Cliente Timeline';
  const phoneNumberId = typeof data.phoneNumberId === 'string' ? data.phoneNumberId : '';
  let peerId = String(data.peerId ?? '5584911112222');
  if (data.conversationId !== undefined) {
    const target = await prisma.conversation.findUnique({ where: { id: String(data.conversationId) }, include: { localContact: true, routes: { include: { contactIdentity: true, businessIdentity: true } } } });
    const owned = target && fixtureConversationIds.has(target.id) && target.routes.length === 1
      ? target.routes[0] : null;
    const channel = owned ? await prisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: { buId: target.buId, type: 'OFICIAL', phoneNumberId, businessIdentityId: owned.businessIdentityId } }) : null;
    const providerIdentity = channel ? await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findFirst({ where: { buId: target.buId, provider: 'OFICIAL', externalResourceId: phoneNumberId, currentChannelId: channel.id, businessIdentityId: owned.businessIdentityId } }) : null;
    const proved = owned?.businessIdentity?.externalResourceId;
    const peer = owned?.contactIdentity?.externalPeerId;
    const canonicalIdentities = target ? await prisma.contactIdentity.findMany({ where: {
      buId: target.buId, contactId: target.contactId, platform: 'WHATSAPP', namespace: 'PERSON', scopeReference: 'BU',
    }, select: { id: true }, take: 2 }) : [];
    const resource = providerInventory.get(phoneNumberId);
    if (!target || !owned || !channel || !providerIdentity || !providerIdentity.managedLifecycle || !proved
      || target.contactType !== 'PESSOA' || target.localContact?.id !== target.contactId
      || owned.buId !== target.buId || owned.conversationId !== target.id || owned.contactId !== target.contactId
      || owned.contactIdentity.buId !== target.buId || owned.contactIdentity.contactId !== target.contactId
      || owned.contactIdentity.platform !== 'WHATSAPP' || owned.contactIdentity.namespace !== 'PERSON'
      || owned.contactIdentity.scopeReference !== 'BU' || canonicalIdentities.length !== 1
      || canonicalIdentities[0].id !== owned.contactIdentityId
      || typeof peer !== 'string' || !/^[1-9]\d{7,14}$/.test(peer)
      || owned.businessScopeReference !== 'BU' || owned.businessIdentity.buId !== target.buId
      || owned.businessIdentity.platform !== 'WHATSAPP' || owned.businessIdentity.namespace !== 'WHATSAPP_RESOURCE'
      || owned.businessIdentity.scopeReference !== 'BU' || channel.id !== providerIdentity.currentChannelId
      || channel.buId !== target.buId || channel.businessIdentityId !== owned.businessIdentityId
      || !resource || resource.id !== phoneNumberId || resource.telefone !== proved) {
      return { status: 404, body: '{"error":"fixture target not found"}' };
    }
    profileName = target.localContact?.displayName ?? target.displayName ?? profileName;
    peerId = peer;
  } else {
    const resource = providerInventory.get(phoneNumberId);
    const channel = resource ? await prisma.buChannel.findFirst({ where: {
      type: 'OFICIAL', phoneNumberId, businessIdentity: { is: { platform: 'WHATSAPP' } },
    }, include: { businessIdentity: true } }) : null;
    const providerIdentity = channel ? await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findFirst({ where: {
      buId: channel.buId, provider: 'OFICIAL', externalResourceId: phoneNumberId,
      currentChannelId: channel.id, businessIdentityId: channel.businessIdentityId, managedLifecycle: true,
    } }) : null;
    const canonical = /^[1-9]\d{7,14}$/.test(peerId);
    if (!resource || resource.id !== phoneNumberId || !channel || !channel.businessIdentity
      || !providerIdentity || !providerIdentity.managedLifecycle
      || channel.businessIdentity.buId !== channel.buId || channel.businessIdentity.platform !== 'WHATSAPP'
      || channel.businessIdentity.namespace !== 'WHATSAPP_RESOURCE' || channel.businessIdentity.scopeReference !== 'BU'
      || channel.businessIdentity.externalResourceId !== resource.telefone
      || providerIdentity.businessIdentityId !== channel.businessIdentityId || !canonical) {
      return { status: 404, body: '{"error":"fixture target not found"}' };
    }
  }
  const id = String(data.id ?? `timeline-event-${Date.now()}`);
  const payload = { entry: [{ changes: [{ field: 'messages', value: {
    metadata: { phone_number_id: data.phoneNumberId },
    contacts: [{ profile: { name: profileName } }],
    messages: [{ id, from: peerId, timestamp: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000), type: 'text', text: { body: String(data.text ?? id) } }],
  } }] }] };
  const raw = JSON.stringify(payload);
  const signature = 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', 'segredo-do-app-meta').update(raw).digest('hex');
  const targetPort = data.target === 'https-browser' ? 3102 : apiPort;
  const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${targetPort}/webhooks/meta`, {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-hub-signature-256': signature }, body: raw,
  });
  return { status: response.status, body: await response.text() };
}

async function instagramProviderRequest(data) {
  const url = new URL(String(data.url));
  const method = String(data.method ?? 'GET').toUpperCase();
  const contentType = String(data.contentType ?? '').split(';', 1)[0].trim().toLowerCase();
  let body = {};
  if (typeof data.body === 'string' && data.body && contentType === 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded') {
    const form = new URLSearchParams(data.body);
    body = Object.fromEntries(form.entries());
  } else if (typeof data.body === 'string' && data.body && contentType === 'application/json') {
    try { body = JSON.parse(data.body); } catch { return { status: 400, body: { error: { message: 'invalid synthetic provider body' } } }; }
  }
  const record = (operation, accountId = null) => onboarding.instagram.calls.push({ operation, accountId });
  if (url.hostname === 'api.instagram.com' && url.pathname === '/oauth/access_token' && method === 'POST') {
    const grant = onboarding.instagram.grants[body.code];
    if (contentType !== 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
      || body.client_id !== 'timeline-instagram-client'
      || body.client_secret !== 'timeline-instagram-client-secret'
      || body.grant_type !== 'authorization_code'
      || body.redirect_uri !== 'https://127.0.0.1:4174/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback'
      || !grant) return { status: 400, body: { error: { message: 'invalid synthetic authorization grant' } } };
    record('oauth.exchange', grant.accountId);
    return { status: 200, body: { data: [{ access_token: `timeline-ig-short:${grant.accountId}`, user_id: grant.accountId, permissions: ['instagram_business_basic', 'instagram_business_manage_messages'] }] } };
  }
  if (url.hostname !== 'graph.instagram.com') throw new Error('Unexpected Instagram fixture host.');
  if (url.pathname === '/access_token' && method === 'GET') {
    const suppliedToken = url.searchParams.get('access_token');
    const grant = Object.values(onboarding.instagram.grants).find((item) => `timeline-ig-short:${item.accountId}` === suppliedToken);
    if (!grant) return { status: 400, body: { error: 'invalid synthetic token' } };
    const accountId = grant.accountId;
    record('oauth.long-token', accountId);
    return { status: 200, body: { access_token: `timeline-ig-access:${accountId}`, expires_in: 3600 } };
  }
  if (url.pathname === '/v26.0/me' && method === 'GET') {
    const suppliedToken = url.searchParams.get('access_token');
    const grant = Object.values(onboarding.instagram.grants).find((item) => `timeline-ig-access:${item.accountId}` === suppliedToken);
    if (!grant) return { status: 400, body: { error: 'invalid synthetic token' } };
    record('account.me', grant.accountId); return { status: 200, body: { user_id: grant.accountId, username: grant.username } };
  }
  const subscribed = url.pathname.match(/^\/v26\.0\/([A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+)\/subscribed_apps$/);
  if (subscribed) {
    const accountId = subscribed[1];
    const token = url.searchParams.get('access_token');
    const grant = Object.values(onboarding.instagram.grants).find((item) => item.accountId === accountId);
    if (!grant || !['GET', 'POST'].includes(method) || token !== `timeline-ig-access:${accountId}`) {
      return { status: 403, body: { error: 'verified synthetic account required' } };
    }
    record(method === 'POST' ? 'subscription.post' : 'subscription.get', accountId);
    return method === 'POST' ? { status: 200, body: { success: true } }
      : { status: 200, body: { data: [{ id: 'timeline-app', subscribed_fields: ['messages'] }] } };
  }
  const send = url.pathname.match(/^\/v26\.0\/([A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+)\/messages$/);
  if (send && method === 'POST') {
    const accountId = send[1];
    const grant = Object.values(onboarding.instagram.grants).find((item) => item.accountId === accountId);
    if (!grant || contentType !== 'application/json'
      || data.authorization !== `Bearer timeline-ig-access:${accountId}`) {
      return { status: 403, body: { error: 'verified synthetic account required' } };
    }
    const message = body;
    const peerId = message?.recipient?.id;
    if (typeof peerId !== 'string' || !['timeline-ig-peer', 'timeline-ig-expired-peer'].includes(peerId)) return { status: 400, body: { error: 'invalid synthetic recipient' } };
    const index = onboarding.instagram.effects.filter((item) => item.operation === 'message.send').length + 1;
    onboarding.instagram.effects.push({ operation: 'message.send', accountId: send[1], peerId });
    return { status: 200, body: onboarding.instagram.sendMode === 'unknown'
      ? { recipient_id: peerId }
      : { recipient_id: peerId, message_id: `timeline-ig-message-${index}` } };
  }
  throw new Error('Unexpected Instagram provider path blocked by the fixture.');
}

async function incomingInstagram(data) {
  const allowed = new Map([
    ['timeline-ig-account-a', new Set(['timeline-ig-peer', 'timeline-ig-expired-peer'])],
    ['timeline-ig-account-b', new Set(['timeline-ig-peer', 'timeline-ig-expired-peer'])],
  ]);
  const accountId = String(data.accountId ?? '');
  const peerId = String(data.peerId ?? 'timeline-ig-peer');
  const recipientId = String(data.recipientAccountId ?? accountId);
  if (!allowed.has(accountId) || !allowed.get(accountId).has(peerId)
    || !allowed.has(recipientId) || (peerId === 'timeline-ig-expired-peer' && data.timestampMode !== 'stale')) return { status: 404, body: '{"error":"fixture target not found"}' };
  const externalId = `timeline-ig-in-${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(16).slice(2, 6)}`;
  const timestamp = data.timestampMode === 'stale' ? Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60_000 : Date.now();
  const username = peerId === 'timeline-ig-expired-peer' ? 'fixture_expired_peer' : 'fixture_peer';
  const event = { object: 'instagram', entry: [{ id: accountId, messaging: [{ sender: { id: peerId, username }, recipient: { id: recipientId }, timestamp, message: { mid: externalId, text: String(data.text ?? 'mensagem Instagram atual') } }] }] };
  const raw = JSON.stringify(event);
  const signature = data.signatureMode === 'wrong'
    ? 'sha256=' + '0'.repeat(64)
    : 'sha256=' + createHmac('sha256', 'timeline-instagram-webhook-secret').update(raw).digest('hex');
  const response = await fetch(`http://127.0.0.1:${Number(process.env.LEADSHUG_INSTAGRAM_API_PORT ?? '3102')}/webhooks/instagram`, {
    method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json', 'x-hub-signature-256': signature }, body: raw,
  });
  const responseBody = await response.text();
  const identity = response.ok ? await prisma.providerResourceIdentity.findFirst({ where: { provider: 'INSTAGRAM', externalResourceId: accountId }, select: { id: true } }) : null;
  const message = identity && response.ok ? await prisma.message.findUnique({ where: { providerResourceIdentityId_externalId: { providerResourceIdentityId: identity.id, externalId } }, select: { id: true, conversationId: true, officialInboundAt: true } }) : null;
  if (message?.conversationId) fixtureConversationIds.add(message.conversationId);
  return { status: response.status, body: responseBody, conversationId: message?.conversationId ?? null, messageId: message?.id ?? null,
    timestamp: message?.officialInboundAt?.toISOString() ?? null };
}

const server = http.createServer(async (req, res) => {
  try {
    if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url.startsWith('/provider/resources')) {
      if (req.headers['x-fixture-provider-token'] !== 'timeline-provider-port-only') return json(res, 403, { error: 'forbidden' });
      const phoneNumberId = new URL(req.url, 'http://fixture.local').searchParams.get('phoneNumberId');
      if (phoneNumberId) return json(res, 200, providerInventory.get(phoneNumberId) ?? null);
      return json(res, 200, onboarding.resources.length ? onboarding.resources : Array.from(providerInventory.values()));
    }
    if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url === '/provider/state') {
      if (req.headers['x-fixture-provider-token'] !== 'timeline-provider-port-only') return json(res, 403, { error: 'forbidden' });
      const inventory = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(onboarding.evolution.inventory).map(([name, item]) => [name, { name, ownerJid: item.ownerJid, connectionStatus: item.connectionStatus }]));
      return json(res, 200, { resources: onboarding.resources, calls: onboarding.calls, effects: onboarding.effects, evolution: { inventory, outcomes: onboarding.evolution.outcomes }, meta: { grantResourceIds: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(onboarding.meta.grants ?? {}).map(([code, grant]) => [code, grant.resources ?? []])), pages: onboarding.meta.pages, sendMode: onboarding.meta.sendMode, templateCalls: onboarding.meta.templateCalls ?? [] }, instagram: { calls: onboarding.instagram.calls, effects: onboarding.instagram.effects }, failures: onboarding.failures, holds: onboarding.holds, holdsAfter: onboarding.holdsAfter, ambiguousAfter: onboarding.ambiguousAfter });
    }
    if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url === '/health') return json(res, 200, { status: 'ok' });
    const data = await bodyOf(req);
    if (req.url.startsWith('/provider/') && req.headers['x-fixture-provider-token'] !== 'timeline-provider-port-only') return json(res, 403, { error: 'forbidden' });
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/config') {
      if (data.reset === true) { onboarding.calls = []; onboarding.effects = []; onboarding.failures = {}; onboarding.holds = {}; onboarding.holdsAfter = {}; onboarding.ambiguousAfter = {}; onboarding.resources = []; onboarding.meta = { codeTokens: {}, grants: {}, pages: {}, sendMode: 'accepted', templates: {}, templateCalls: [] }; onboarding.evolution = { inventory: {}, outcomes: {} }; onboarding.instagram = { calls: [], effects: [], sendMode: 'accepted', grants: { 'timeline-instagram-code-a': { accountId: 'timeline-ig-account-a', username: 'timeline_account_a' }, 'timeline-instagram-code-b': { accountId: 'timeline-ig-account-b', username: 'timeline_account_b' } } }; providerInventory.clear(); barriers.clear(); }
      if (Array.isArray(data.resources)) onboarding.resources = data.resources.map((r) => ({ ...r }));
      if (data.meta && typeof data.meta === 'object') Object.assign(onboarding.meta, data.meta);
      if (data.evolution && typeof data.evolution === 'object') Object.assign(onboarding.evolution, data.evolution);
      if (data.failures && typeof data.failures === 'object') onboarding.failures = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(data.failures).map(([k, v]) => [k, { remaining: Math.max(1, Number(v.remaining ?? 1)), message: String(v.message ?? 'controlled provider failure') }]));
      if (data.holds && typeof data.holds === 'object') onboarding.holds = { ...data.holds };
      if (data.holdsAfter && typeof data.holdsAfter === 'object') onboarding.holdsAfter = { ...data.holdsAfter };
      if (data.ambiguousAfter && typeof data.ambiguousAfter === 'object') onboarding.ambiguousAfter = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(data.ambiguousAfter).map(([k, v]) => [k, { remaining: Math.max(1, Number(v.remaining ?? 1)) }]));
      return json(res, 200, { configured: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/instagram/config') {
      if (!['accepted', 'unknown'].includes(data.sendMode)) return json(res, 400, { error: 'invalid fixture send mode' });
      onboarding.instagram.sendMode = data.sendMode;
      return json(res, 200, { configured: true });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/instagram/request') {
      const result = await instagramProviderRequest(data);
      return json(res, result.status, result.body);
    }
    if (req.method === 'GET' && req.url === '/provider/instagram/state') {
      return json(res, 200, { calls: onboarding.instagram.calls, effects: onboarding.instagram.effects, sendMode: onboarding.instagram.sendMode });
    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/provider/instagram/attempts') {
      const buId = typeof data.buId === 'string' ? data.buId : '';
      const accountId = typeof data.accountId === 'string' ? data.accountId : '';
      if (!fixtureBusinessUnitIds.has(buId) || !['timeline-ig-account-a', 'timeline-ig-account-b'].includes(accountId)) return json(res, 404, { error: 'fixture scope not found' });
      const accountChannels = await prisma.buChannel.findMany({ where: { buId, type: 'INSTAGRAM', businessIdentity: { is: { externalResourceId: accountId } } }, select: { id: true } });
      const attempts = await prisma.instagramAuthorizationAttempt.findMany({ where: { buId, OR: [
        { professionalUserId: accountId }, { operation: 'REAUTHORIZE', channelId: { in: accountChannels.map((item) => item.id) } },
      ] },

    }
    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/restore-fixture-grant') {

      const buId = typeof data.businessUnitId === 'string' ? data.businessUnitId : '';

    if (req.method === 'POST' && req.url === '/burst') {

      const base = new Date(data.createdAt ?? Date.now());
      await prisma.message.createMany({ data: Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => ({
        conversationId: conversation.id, buId: conversation.buId, direction: 'IN', messageType: 'TEXTO',
        content: `burst ${i + 1}`, channelOrigin: 'OFICIAL', status: 'RECEBIDA',
        createdAt: new Date(base.getTime() + i),
      })) });
      return json(res, 201, { count });
    }
    return json(res, 404, { error: 'not found' });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(error);
    return json(res, 500, { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
  }
});
server.listen(fixturePort, '127.0.0.1', () => console.log(`timeline fixtures listening on 127.0.0.1:${fixturePort}`));
process.on('SIGTERM', () => server.close(() => prisma.$disconnect().finally(() => process.exit(0))));
process.on('SIGINT', () => server.close(() => prisma.$disconnect().finally(() => process.exit(0))));

import { expect, test, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';

const FIXTURES = 'http://127.0.0.1:3101';
const FRONTDOOR = 'https://127.0.0.1:4174';

test.use({ baseURL: FRONTDOOR, ignoreHTTPSErrors: true });

async function seed(request: APIRequestContext, includeEvolution = false, count = 3) {
  const response = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/seed`, { data: { count, includeEvolution, requiresWindow: true } });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(201);
  return response.json() as Promise<{
    email: string; password: string; businessUnitId: string; conversationId: string;
    otherConversationId: string; otherBusinessUnitId: string; otherBuConversationId: string; otherBuPhoneNumberId: string; phoneNumberId: string;
  }>;
}

async function holdNativeReply(request: APIRequestContext, conversationId: string) {
  const response = await request.post(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/hold`, { data: { conversationId } });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
}

async function pendingNativeReply(request: APIRequestContext) {
  let state: { pending: null | { status: number; bodyHash: string; bodyBytes: number; headers: Record<string, unknown> } } = { pending: null };
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 200 && !state.pending; attempt += 1) {
    const response = await request.get(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/state`);
    expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
    state = await response.json();
    if (!state.pending) await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25));
  }
  expect(state.pending).not.toBeNull();
  return state.pending!;
}

async function releaseNativeReply(request: APIRequestContext) {
  const response = await request.post(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/release`);
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
}

async function loginAndOpen(page: Page, fixture: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof seed>>, messages = 3) {
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  await page.goto('/login');
  await page.getByLabel('E-mail').fill(fixture.email);
  await page.getByLabel('Senha').fill(fixture.password);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Entrar' }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/inbox$/);
  await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(fixture.businessUnitId);
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Timeline' }).click();
  await expect(page.locator('.bolha')).toHaveCount(messages);
}

  test('seleciona explicitamente a rota V2 e descarta resposta atrasada após troca A→B→A', async ({ page, request }) => {

    const evolution = routeOptions.find((item) => /não oficial/i.test(item.label));

    await channelSelect.selectOption(evolution!.value);

    await holdNativeReply(request, fixture.conversationId);
    let released = false;
    try {
      const responsePath = `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/messages`;
    await page.evaluate((pathname) => {
      type BodyReadState = {
        started: number;
        settled: number;
        processed: number;
        completion: Promise<void>;
        resolveCompletion: () => void;
        originalFetch: typeof window.fetch;
      };
      const w = window as typeof window & { __stcon06BodyRead?: BodyReadState };
      let resolveCompletion!: () => void;
      const state: BodyReadState = {
        started: 0,
        settled: 0,
        processed: 0,
        completion: new Promise<void>((resolve) => { resolveCompletion = resolve; }),
        resolveCompletion: () => resolveCompletion(),
        originalFetch: window.fetch,
      };
      const nativeFetch = window.fetch.bind(window);
      window.fetch = async (input, init) => {
        const requestUrl = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input);
        const method = init?.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET');
        const response = await nativeFetch(input, init);
        if (method === 'POST' && new URL(requestUrl, window.location.href).pathname === pathname) {
          const nativeText = response.text.bind(response);
          response.text = () => {
            state.started += 1;
            return nativeText().then((body) => {
              state.settled += 1;
              // A browser task runs after this promise and the awaiting api.ts / responder
              // microtasks, including the generation fence and draft decision.
              window.setTimeout(() => {
                state.processed += 1;
                state.resolveCompletion();
              }, 0);
              return body;
            });
          };
        }
        return response;
      };
      w.__stcon06BodyRead = state;
    }, responsePath);
    await composer.fill('resposta cuja resposta chega tarde');
    const solicitacao = page.waitForRequest((requestEvent) => requestEvent.method() === 'POST' && new URL(requestEvent.url()).pathname === responsePath);
