    const currentRoutes = await channelSelect.locator('option').evaluateAll((items) => items.map((item) => ({ value: (item as HTMLOptionElement).value, label: item.textContent ?? '' })));
    const currentEvolution = currentRoutes.find((item) => item.value === evolution!.value && /não oficial/i.test(item.label));
    expect(currentEvolution).toBeTruthy();
    await channelSelect.selectOption(currentEvolution!.value);
    await composer.fill('resposta cuja resposta chega tarde');
      await releaseNativeReply(request);
      released = true;
    const responseAntiga = await responsePromise;
    expect(responseAntiga.status()).toBe(201);
    expect(await responseAntiga.finished()).toBeNull();
    const frontdoorState = await (await request.get(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/state`)).json();
    const responseBody = await responseAntiga.body();
    expect(frontdoorState.completed).toMatchObject({ status: 201, bodyBytes: responseBody.byteLength });
    expect(frontdoorState.completed.bodyHash).toBe(await import('node:crypto').then(({ createHash }) => createHash('sha256').update(responseBody).digest('hex')));
    expect(frontdoorState.completed.headers['content-type']).toContain('application/json');
    const bodyRead = await page.evaluate(async () => {
      const state = (window as typeof window & { __stcon06BodyRead?: {
        completion: Promise<void>; started: number; settled: number; processed: number; originalFetch: typeof window.fetch;
      } }).__stcon06BodyRead;
      if (!state) throw new Error('The response body read instrumentation was not installed.');
      await state.completion;
      window.fetch = state.originalFetch;
      return { started: state.started, settled: state.settled, processed: state.processed };
    });
    expect(bodyRead).toEqual({ started: 1, settled: 1, processed: 1 });
    await expect(composer).toHaveValue('resposta cuja resposta chega tarde');
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toHaveCount(0);
    } finally {
      if (!released) await request.post(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/release`).catch(() => undefined);
      await page.evaluate(() => {
        const state = (window as typeof window & { __stcon06BodyRead?: { originalFetch: typeof window.fetch } }).__stcon06BodyRead;
        if (state) window.fetch = state.originalFetch;

  test('repete opções após uma falha atrasada atravessar uma reconexão real do socket', async ({ page, request }) => {
    const fixture = await seed(request);
    const incoming = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/incoming`, { data: {
      conversationId: fixture.conversationId, phoneNumberId: fixture.phoneNumberId,
      text: 'entrada qualificada para a conversa atual', target: 'https-browser',
    } });
    expect(incoming.status()).toBe(200);
    expect((await incoming.json()).status).toBe(200);

    const providerHeaders = { 'x-fixture-provider-token': 'timeline-provider-port-only' };
    const providerBeforeResponse = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, { headers: providerHeaders });
    expect(providerBeforeResponse.status()).toBe(200);
    const sendsBefore = ((await providerBeforeResponse.json()).calls as Array<{ operation: string }>).filter((call) => call.operation === 'meta.send').length;

    const connectedSockets = new Set<import('@playwright/test').WebSocket>();
    const closedSockets = new Set<import('@playwright/test').WebSocket>();
    page.on('websocket', (socket) => {
      if (socket.url() !== 'wss://127.0.0.1:4174/ws') return;
      socket.on('close', () => closedSockets.add(socket));
      socket.on('framereceived', (frame) => {
        try {
          const event: unknown = JSON.parse(typeof frame.payload === 'string' ? frame.payload : frame.payload.toString());
          if (event && typeof event === 'object' && !Array.isArray(event)
            && (event as { tipo?: unknown }).tipo === 'conectado'
            && Array.isArray((event as { escopo?: unknown }).escopo)
            && (event as { escopo: string[] }).escopo.includes(fixture.businessUnitId)) connectedSockets.add(socket);
        } catch { /* Ignore non-JSON websocket frames. */ }
      });
    });

    let resolveFirstOptionsHeld!: () => void;
    const firstOptionsHeld = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { resolveFirstOptionsHeld = resolve; });
    let abortFirstOptions!: () => void;
    const abortFirstOptionsRequest = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { abortFirstOptions = resolve; });
    let optionsRequests = 0;
    const optionsRoute = `**/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/start-options`;
    let firstOptionsRouteCallbackFinished: Promise<void> | null = null;
    let finishFirstOptionsRouteCallback: (() => void) | null = null;
    const optionsRouteHandler = async (route: import('@playwright/test').Route) => {
      optionsRequests += 1;
      if (optionsRequests === 1) {
        firstOptionsRouteCallbackFinished = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { finishFirstOptionsRouteCallback = resolve; });
        resolveFirstOptionsHeld();
        try {
          await abortFirstOptionsRequest;
          await route.abort('failed');
        } catch (error) {
          if (route.request().failure()?.errorText !== 'net::ERR_ABORTED') throw error;
        } finally {
          finishFirstOptionsRouteCallback?.();
        }
        return;
      }
      await route.continue();
    };
    await page.route(optionsRoute, optionsRouteHandler);

    let routeReleased = false;
    try {
      await loginAndOpen(page, fixture, 4);
      await firstOptionsHeld;
      await expect.poll(() => connectedSockets.size).toBe(1);
      const composer = page.getByPlaceholder('Escreva uma resposta');
      await expect(page.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: /Conferindo/ })).toBeVisible();
      await expect(composer).toHaveCount(0);

      const socketDropResponse = await request.post(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/drop-wss`, {
        headers: { 'x-fixture-wss-control': 'native109-raw-wss-close-only' },
      });
      expect(socketDropResponse.status()).toBe(200);
      expect(await socketDropResponse.json()).toEqual({ closed: 1 });
      await expect.poll(() => closedSockets.size).toBe(1);
      await expect.poll(() => connectedSockets.size, { timeout: 15_000 }).toBeGreaterThan(1);

      const retryResponsePromise = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'GET'
        && new URL(response.url()).pathname === `/api/bff/conversations/${fixture.conversationId}/start-options`);
      abortFirstOptions();
      routeReleased = true;
      const retryResponse = await retryResponsePromise;
      expect(retryResponse.status()).toBe(200);
      expect(optionsRequests).toBe(2);

      await expect(page.getByLabel('Business Unit')).toHaveValue(fixture.businessUnitId);
      await expect(page.locator('.cartao.lista .item.ativo')).toContainText('Cliente Timeline');
      await expect(composer).toBeVisible();
      await composer.fill('rascunho digitado após a recuperação');
      await expect(composer).toHaveValue('rascunho digitado após a recuperação');
      expect(await page.getByRole('alert').allTextContents()).toEqual([]);

      const providerAfterResponse = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, { headers: providerHeaders });
      expect(providerAfterResponse.status()).toBe(200);
      const sendsAfter = ((await providerAfterResponse.json()).calls as Array<{ operation: string }>).filter((call) => call.operation === 'meta.send').length;
      expect(sendsAfter).toBe(sendsBefore);
      const auditResponse = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit-outbound?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(fixture.conversationId)}&content=${encodeURIComponent('rascunho digitado após a recuperação')}`);
      expect(auditResponse.status()).toBe(200);
      expect((await auditResponse.json()).total).toBe(0);
    } finally {
      if (!routeReleased) {
        abortFirstOptions();
        routeReleased = true;
      }
      if (firstOptionsRouteCallbackFinished) await firstOptionsRouteCallbackFinished;
      await page.unroute(optionsRoute, optionsRouteHandler);
    }
  });

  test('bloqueia vinte novos submits durante cada envio real em cinco ondas', async ({ page, request }) => {
    const fixture = await seed(request);
    const incoming = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/incoming`, { data: {
      conversationId: fixture.conversationId, phoneNumberId: fixture.phoneNumberId,
      text: 'entrada oficial assinada e atual para as cinco ondas', target: 'https-browser',
    } });
    expect(incoming.status()).toBe(200);
    expect((await incoming.json()).status).toBe(200);
    for (const [conversationId, phoneNumberId, text] of [
      [fixture.otherConversationId, fixture.phoneNumberId, 'entrada secundária para onda isolada'],
      [fixture.otherBuConversationId, fixture.otherBuPhoneNumberId, 'entrada alternativa para onda isolada'],
    ]) {
      const received = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/incoming`, { data: { conversationId, phoneNumberId, text, target: 'https-browser' } });
      expect(received.status()).toBe(200);
      expect((await received.json()).status).toBe(200);
    }
    await loginAndOpen(page, fixture, 4);
    const composer = page.getByPlaceholder('Escreva uma resposta');
    const providerStateResponse = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, { headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': 'timeline-provider-port-only' } });
    expect(providerStateResponse.status()).toBe(200);
    const providerCallsAtStart = (await providerStateResponse.json()).calls as Array<{ operation: string }>;
    const sendsAtStart = providerCallsAtStart.filter((call) => call.operation === 'meta.send').length;
    const waveEvidence: Array<{ requests: number; retriggers: number; outcome: 'accepted' | 'unknown'; draftPreserved: boolean; messageCount: number }> = [];
    const form = page.locator('form').filter({ has: composer });
    for (let round = 0; round < 5; round += 1) {
      const outcome = round % 2 === 1 ? 'unknown' : 'accepted';
      const conversationId = round === 1 ? fixture.otherConversationId : round === 3 ? fixture.otherBuConversationId : fixture.conversationId;
      if (round === 1) {
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Na fila' }).click();
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Secundário' }).click();
        await expect(composer).toBeVisible();
      } else if (round === 2 || round === 4) {
        await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(fixture.businessUnitId);
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Em atendimento' }).click();
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Timeline' }).click();
        await expect(composer).toBeVisible();
      } else if (round === 3) {
        await page.getByLabel('Business Unit').selectOption(fixture.otherBusinessUnitId);
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Na fila' }).click();
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cliente Outra BU' }).click();
        await expect(composer).toBeVisible();
      }
      const text = `composer wave ${round} ${outcome}`;
      await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/send-mode`, { data: { mode: outcome } });
      let requestCount = 0;
      let actualStatus = 0;
      await holdNativeReply(request, conversationId);
      let released = false;
      let observeRequest: ((requestEvent: import('@playwright/test').Request) => void) | undefined;
      let responseObserver: ReturnType<Page['waitForResponse']> | undefined;
      try {
        const responsePath = `/api/bff/conversations/${conversationId}/messages`;
        const outgoingRequests: string[] = [];
        observeRequest = (requestEvent: import('@playwright/test').Request) => {
          if (requestEvent.method() === 'POST' && new URL(requestEvent.url()).pathname === responsePath) { requestCount += 1; outgoingRequests.push(requestEvent.url()); }
        };
        page.on('request', observeRequest);
        await composer.fill(text);
        await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar' }).click();
        const responsePromise = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST' && new URL(response.url()).pathname === responsePath);
        responseObserver = responsePromise;
        void responsePromise.catch(() => undefined);
        await pendingNativeReply(request);
        const state = await (await request.get(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/state`)).json();
        actualStatus = state.pending.status;
        for (let index = 0; index < 20; index += 1) {
          await form.evaluate((element) => element.dispatchEvent(new Event('submit', { bubbles: true, cancelable: true })));
        }
        expect(requestCount).toBe(1);
        await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviando…' })).toBeDisabled();
        await releaseNativeReply(request);
        released = true;
        const completedResponse = await responsePromise;
        expect(completedResponse.status()).toBe(actualStatus);
        if (outcome === 'unknown') {
          await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('aceitou o envio sem confirmar o ID externo');
          await expect(composer).toHaveValue(text);
          expect(actualStatus).toBe(409);
        } else {
          await expect(page.locator('.bolha').filter({ hasText: text })).toBeVisible();
          await expect(composer).toHaveValue('');
          expect(actualStatus).toBe(201);
        }
        const auditResponse = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/audit-outbound?conversationId=${encodeURIComponent(conversationId)}&content=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`);
        expect(auditResponse.status()).toBe(200);
        const audit = await auditResponse.json() as { total: number; accepted: number; failed: number; failedWithoutExternalId: number };
        expect(audit).toEqual(outcome === 'unknown'
          ? { total: 1, accepted: 0, failed: 1, failedWithoutExternalId: 1 }
          : { total: 1, accepted: 1, failed: 0, failedWithoutExternalId: 0 });
        const providerState = await request.get(`${FIXTURES}/provider/state`, { headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': 'timeline-provider-port-only' } });
        expect(providerState.status()).toBe(200);
        const providerCalls = (await providerState.json()).calls as Array<{ operation: string }>;
        expect(providerCalls.filter((call) => call.operation === 'meta.send')).toHaveLength(sendsAtStart + round + 1);
        waveEvidence.push({ requests: requestCount, retriggers: 20, outcome, draftPreserved: outcome === 'unknown', messageCount: audit.total });
        if (outcome === 'unknown') {
          await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Atualizar opções' }).click();
          await expect(composer).toHaveValue(text);
          await expect(composer).toBeDisabled();
          await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Enviar', exact: true })).toBeDisabled();
        }
      } finally {
        if (observeRequest) page.off('request', observeRequest);
        if (!released) await request.post(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/release`).catch(() => undefined);
        if (responseObserver) void responseObserver.catch(() => undefined);
      }
    }
    expect(waveEvidence).toHaveLength(5);
    expect(waveEvidence.every((wave) => wave.requests === 1 && wave.retriggers === 20)).toBe(true);
    expect(waveEvidence.filter((wave) => wave.outcome === 'accepted').every((wave) => wave.messageCount === 1 && !wave.draftPreserved)).toBe(true);
    expect(waveEvidence.filter((wave) => wave.outcome === 'unknown').every((wave) => wave.messageCount === 1 && wave.draftPreserved)).toBe(true);
    console.log(`[FRC-COMPOSER-EVIDENCE]${JSON.stringify({ waves: waveEvidence, limits: 'Five real BFF/PostgreSQL submits held after the actual response; twenty user-form submit events per in-flight send; one request per wave; no capacity/SLO claim.' })}`);
  });
});

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { createRequire } from 'node:module';
import { request as httpsRequest } from 'node:https';
import { readFile, stat } from 'node:fs/promises';
import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';

const sha256 = (value: Buffer | string) => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');

function getHttps(path: string): Promise<{ status: number; headers: Record<string, string | string[] | undefined>; body: Buffer }> {
  return new Promise((resolveResponse, reject) => {
    const request = httpsRequest(`https://127.0.0.1:4174${path}`, { method: 'GET', rejectUnauthorized: false }, (response) => {
      const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
      response.on('data', (chunk: Buffer | string) => chunks.push(Buffer.from(chunk)));
      response.on('end', () => resolveResponse({ status: response.statusCode ?? 0, headers: response.headers, body: Buffer.concat(chunks) }));
    });
    request.on('error', reject);
    request.end();
  });
}

export async function verifyInstagramFreshness() {
  const web = process.cwd();
  const root = resolve(web, '..');
  const api = join(root, 'api-app');
  const runtime = process.version;
  if (!/^v22\./.test(runtime)) throw new Error(`Instagram browser proof requires Node 22; received ${runtime}`);

  const databaseUrl = process.env.LEADSHUG_E2E_DATABASE_URL;
  if (!databaseUrl || databaseUrl !== process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('The dedicated E2E database URL is not the active guarded database URL.');
  const parsedDatabaseUrl = new URL(databaseUrl);
  const databaseName = decodeURIComponent(parsedDatabaseUrl.pathname.slice(1));
  if (!databaseName.startsWith('leadshug_timeline_')) throw new Error('Instagram browser proof requires a disposable leadshug_timeline_* database.');

  const [apiHealth, fixtureHealth, htmlResponse] = await Promise.all([
    getHttps('/health'), fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3101/health'), getHttps('/'),
  ]);
  if (apiHealth.status !== 200 || apiHealth.headers['x-leadshug-owned-api-child'] !== '3102') throw new Error('HTTPS API is not served by the owned Nest child on port 3102.');
  if (!fixtureHealth.ok) throw new Error(`The browser fixture server is unavailable: HTTP ${fixtureHealth.status}`);
  if (htmlResponse.status !== 200) throw new Error(`The HTTPS frontdoor did not serve the built UI: HTTP ${htmlResponse.status}`);
  const html = htmlResponse.body.toString('utf8');
  const scripts = [...html.matchAll(/(?:src|href)=["']([^"']+\.js(?:\?[^"']*)?)["']/g)].map((match) => match[1]);
  const asset = scripts.find((value) => /(?:^|\/)assets\//.test(value));
  if (!asset) throw new Error('The built HTTPS UI does not reference a JavaScript asset.');
  const assetUrl = new URL(asset, 'https://127.0.0.1:4174');
  const servedBundleResponse = await getHttps(`${assetUrl.pathname}${assetUrl.search}`);
  if (servedBundleResponse.status !== 200) throw new Error(`The HTTPS-served UI bundle returned HTTP ${servedBundleResponse.status}.`);
  const bundlePath = resolve(web, 'dist', `.${assetUrl.pathname}`);
  const servedBundle = servedBundleResponse.body;
  const distBundle = await readFile(bundlePath);
  const servedBundleSha256 = sha256(servedBundle);
  const distBundleSha256 = sha256(distBundle);
  if (servedBundleSha256 !== distBundleSha256) throw new Error('The bundle served through the HTTPS frontdoor does not match the current web-app/dist artifact.');

  const requireFromApi = createRequire(join(api, 'package.json'));
  const { PrismaClient } = requireFromApi('@prisma/client') as { PrismaClient: new (options: { datasources: { db: { url: string } } }) => any };
  const prisma = new PrismaClient({ datasources: { db: { url: databaseUrl } } });
  let databaseVersion: string;
  let completedMigrations: number;
  try {
    const rows = await prisma.$queryRawUnsafe('SELECT version() AS version, COUNT(*) OVER ()::int AS migration_count FROM "_prisma_migrations" WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND rolled_back_at IS NULL LIMIT 1') as Array<{ version: string; migration_count: number }>;
    databaseVersion = String(rows[0]?.version ?? '');
    completedMigrations = Number(rows[0]?.migration_count ?? 0);
  } finally { await prisma.$disconnect(); }
  if (!/PostgreSQL 16\./.test(databaseVersion)) throw new Error('The guarded browser database is not PostgreSQL 16.');
  if (completedMigrations <= 0) throw new Error('The guarded browser database has no completed migrations.');

  const sourceArtifacts = [
    ['src/surfaces/webhooks/instagram.controller.ts', 'dist/surfaces/webhooks/instagram.controller.js'],
    ['src/surfaces/bff/instagram-authorizations.controller.ts', 'dist/surfaces/bff/instagram-authorizations.controller.js'],
    ['src/domain/channels/instagram-authorization.service.ts', 'dist/domain/channels/instagram-authorization.service.js'],
    ['src/integrations/instagram/instagram-http.client.ts', 'dist/integrations/instagram/instagram-http.client.js'],
    ['src/integrations/instagram/instagram-messaging.client.ts', 'dist/integrations/instagram/instagram-messaging.client.js'],
  ] as const;
  const compiledEvidence = await Promise.all(sourceArtifacts.map(async ([sourceRelative, artifactRelative]) => {
    const sourcePath = join(api, sourceRelative);
    const artifactPath = join(api, artifactRelative);
    const [source, artifact, sourceStat, artifactStat] = await Promise.all([
      readFile(sourcePath), readFile(artifactPath), stat(sourcePath), stat(artifactPath),
    ]);
    if (artifactStat.mtimeMs < sourceStat.mtimeMs) throw new Error(`The active Nest artifact predates its qualified source: ${sourceRelative}`);
    return { source: sourceRelative, sourceSha256: sha256(source), artifact: artifactRelative, artifactSha256: sha256(artifact) };
  }));

  const currentPublicPaths = [
    'api-app/test/browser-server.cjs', 'api-app/test/timeline-fixtures.cjs',
    'web-app/e2e/channel-transport.spec.ts', 'web-app/e2e/start-conversation.spec.ts',
    'web-app/e2e/instagram-channel.spec.ts', 'web-app/e2e/instagram-channel-freshness.ts',
  ];
  const publicInventory = await Promise.all(currentPublicPaths.map(async (relativePath) => ({
    path: relativePath, bytes: (await readFile(join(root, relativePath))).byteLength,
    sha256: sha256(await readFile(join(root, relativePath))),
  })));

  return {
    runtime, database: { name: databaseName, version: databaseVersion, completedMigrations },
    endpoints: { ownedHttpsChild: apiHealth.status, fixtureHealth: fixtureHealth.status, servedUi: htmlResponse.status,
      servedBundle: assetUrl.pathname, servedBundleSha256, distBundleSha256 },
    compiledEvidence, currentPublicInventory: publicInventory,
  };
}

import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
import { expect, test, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';
import { verifyInstagramFreshness } from './instagram-channel-freshness';

const FIXTURES = 'http://127.0.0.1:3101';
const FRONTDOOR = 'https://127.0.0.1:4174';
const FIXTURE_TOKEN = 'timeline-provider-port-only';

test.use({ baseURL: FRONTDOOR, ignoreHTTPSErrors: true });
test.beforeAll(async () => { await verifyInstagramFreshness(); });

type Fixture = { email: string; password: string; operatorEmail: string; operatorPassword: string; businessUnitId: string; conversationId: string };
type Incoming = { status: number; body: string; conversationId: string | null; messageId: string | null; timestamp: string | null };
type RealtimeFrame = { socketId: number; url: string; payload: string };

function isNativeRealtimeSocket(url: string) {
  const parsed = new URL(url);
  return parsed.protocol === 'wss:' && parsed.host === '127.0.0.1:4174' && parsed.pathname === '/ws';
}

function parseRealtimeFrame(frame: RealtimeFrame): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(frame.payload);
    return parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)
      ? parsed as Record<string, unknown>
      : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function hasRealtimeConnection(frames: RealtimeFrame[], socketId: number | null, buId: string) {
  return socketId !== null && frames.some((frame) => {
    if (frame.socketId !== socketId || !isNativeRealtimeSocket(frame.url)) return false;
    const event = parseRealtimeFrame(frame);
    return event?.tipo === 'conectado' && Array.isArray(event.escopo) && event.escopo.includes(buId);
  });
}

function countRealtimeIncoming(frames: RealtimeFrame[], socketId: number | null, conversationId: string, buId: string) {
  if (socketId === null) return 0;
  return frames.filter((frame) => {
    if (frame.socketId !== socketId || !isNativeRealtimeSocket(frame.url)) return false;
    const event = parseRealtimeFrame(frame);
    return event?.tipo === 'mensagem' && event.buId === buId
      && event.conversaId === conversationId && event.direcao === 'IN';
  }).length;
}

async function seed(request: APIRequestContext): Promise<Fixture> {
  const response = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}/seed`, { data: { count: 3, includeEvolution: false, includeOperator: true } });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(201);
  return response.json();
}

async function fixturePost(request: APIRequestContext, path: string, data: unknown) {
  const response = await request.post(`${FIXTURES}${path}`, {
    headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN }, data,
  });
  return response;
}

async function fixtureGet(request: APIRequestContext, path: string) {
  return request.get(`${FIXTURES}${path}`, { headers: { 'x-fixture-provider-token': FIXTURE_TOKEN } });
}

async function login(page: Page, fixture: Fixture, operator = false) {
  await page.goto(`${FRONTDOOR}/login`);
  await page.getByLabel('E-mail').fill(operator ? fixture.operatorEmail : fixture.email);
  await page.getByLabel('Senha').fill(operator ? fixture.operatorPassword : fixture.password);
  const loginResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST' && /\/api\/bff\/auth\/login$/.test(new URL(response.url()).pathname));
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Entrar' }).click();
  const response = await loginResponse;
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
  const cookies = await page.context().cookies(FRONTDOOR);
  expect(cookies.some((cookie) => cookie.httpOnly && cookie.secure && cookie.sameSite === 'None')).toBe(true);
}

async function connectAccount(page: Page, request: APIRequestContext, fixture: Fixture, account: 'a' | 'b') {
  const userName = account === 'a' ? 'timeline_account_a' : 'timeline_account_b';
  const code = `timeline-instagram-code-${account}`;
  await page.goto('/numeros');
  await page.unroute('https://www.instagram.com/oauth/authorize**');
  const section = page.locator('section[aria-label="Conexões de canais · Número timeline"]');
  const connect = section.getByRole('button', { name: 'Conectar conta Instagram' });
  await expect(connect).toBeEnabled();
  await page.route('https://www.instagram.com/oauth/authorize**', async (route) => {
    const authorization = new URL(route.request().url());
    const callback = authorization.searchParams.get('redirect_uri');
    const state = authorization.searchParams.get('state');
    expect(callback).toBeTruthy();
    expect(state).toBeTruthy();
    const callbackUrl = new URL(callback!);
    callbackUrl.searchParams.set('code', code);
    callbackUrl.searchParams.set('state', state!);
    await route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/html', body: `<!doctype html><meta charset="utf-8"><script>location.replace(${JSON.stringify(callbackUrl.toString())})</script>` });
  });
  const externalAuthorizationRequest = page.waitForRequest((outgoing) => {
    const url = new URL(outgoing.url());
    return url.hostname === 'www.instagram.com' && url.pathname === '/oauth/authorize';

  const callback = page.waitForResponse((response) => new URL(response.url()).pathname === '/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback');
  await connect.click();
  const authorizationRequest = await externalAuthorizationRequest;
  const authorizationUrl = new URL(authorizationRequest.url());
  expect(authorizationUrl.searchParams.get('client_id')).toBe('timeline-instagram-client');
  expect(authorizationUrl.searchParams.get('response_type')).toBe('code');
  expect(authorizationUrl.searchParams.get('redirect_uri')).toBe('https://127.0.0.1:4174/api/bff/instagram-authorizations/callback');
  expect(authorizationUrl.searchParams.get('state')).toBeTruthy();
  const callbackResponse = await callback;
  expect(callbackResponse.status()).toBe(303);
  expect(callbackResponse.headers()['cache-control']).toContain('no-store');
  expect(callbackResponse.headers()['referrer-policy']).toBe('no-referrer');
  await expect(section.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar conta' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/numeros$/);
  const confirmationResponse = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.request().method() === 'POST'
    && /^\/api\/bff\/instagram-authorizations\/[^/]+\/confirm$/.test(new URL(response.url()).pathname));
  await section.getByRole('button', { name: 'Confirmar conta' }).click();
  const confirmed = await confirmationResponse;
  expect(confirmed.status()).toBe(200);
  expect(await confirmed.finished()).toBeNull();
  const attemptsResponse = await fixturePost(request, '/provider/instagram/attempts', {
    buId: fixture.businessUnitId, accountId: `timeline-ig-account-${account}`,
  });
  expect(attemptsResponse.status()).toBe(200);
  const { attempts } = await attemptsResponse.json();
  expect(attempts).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(attempts[0]).toMatchObject({ status: 'MAPPED_PENDING_RECEIPT', username: userName, subscriptionState: 'SUBSCRIBED', subscriptionRequests: 1 });
  expect(JSON.stringify(attempts)).not.toMatch(/code|token|stateHash|credentialCiphertext/i);

  const accountCard = section.locator('article').filter({ hasText: `@${userName}` });
  await expect(accountCard.locator('strong')).toHaveText(`@${userName}`);
  await expect(accountCard.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Conexão em andamento');
  await expect(accountCard.getByText(/recebimento/i)).toBeVisible();
  await page.waitForTimeout(10_500);
  await accountCard.getByRole('button', { name: 'Verificar conexão' }).click();
  await expect(section.getByRole('status').filter({ hasText: 'A verificação da conta ainda não foi confirmada' })).toBeVisible();
  const provider = await (await fixtureGet(request, '/provider/instagram/state')).json();
  expect(provider.calls.filter((item: { operation: string; accountId: string }) => item.accountId === `timeline-ig-account-${account}` && item.operation === 'subscription.get')).toHaveLength(1);
  expect(provider.calls.filter((item: { operation: string; accountId: string }) => item.accountId === `timeline-ig-account-${account}` && item.operation === 'subscription.post')).toHaveLength(1);
  const beforeReceipt = await (await fixturePost(request, '/provider/instagram/observe', { accountId: `timeline-ig-account-${account}` })).json();
  expect(beforeReceipt).toMatchObject({ connected: true, routes: 0, qualifiedInbound: 0, providerIdentity: true, receiptVerifiedAt: null });
  return attempts[0] as { id: string };
}

async function signedIncoming(request: APIRequestContext, account: 'a' | 'b', text: string): Promise<Incoming> {
  const response = await fixturePost(request, '/provider/instagram/incoming', {
    accountId: `timeline-ig-account-${account}`, text,
  });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
  const result = await response.json() as Incoming;
  expect(result.status).toBe(200);
  expect(result.conversationId).toBeTruthy();
  expect(result.messageId).toBeTruthy();
  expect(result.timestamp).toBeTruthy();
  return result;
}

async function assertInstagramFakeCredentialBoundaries(request: APIRequestContext) {
  const before = await (await fixtureGet(request, '/provider/instagram/state')).json();
  const rejectedExchange = await fixturePost(request, '/provider/instagram/request', {
    url: 'https://api.instagram.com/oauth/access_token', method: 'POST',
    contentType: 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
    body: new URLSearchParams({
      client_id: 'timeline-instagram-client', client_secret: 'timeline-instagram-client-secret',
      grant_type: 'authorization_code', redirect_uri: 'https://127.0.0.1:4174/wrong-callback',
      code: 'timeline-instagram-code-a',
    }).toString(),
  });
  expect(rejectedExchange.status()).toBe(400);
  const rejectedSubscription = await fixturePost(request, '/provider/instagram/request', {
    url: 'https://graph.instagram.com/v26.0/timeline-ig-account-a/subscribed_apps?access_token=timeline-ig-access:timeline-ig-account-b',
    method: 'GET', contentType: null, authorization: null, body: null,
  });
  expect(rejectedSubscription.status()).toBe(403);
  const rejectedSend = await fixturePost(request, '/provider/instagram/request', {
    url: 'https://graph.instagram.com/v26.0/timeline-ig-account-a/messages', method: 'POST',
    contentType: 'application/json', authorization: 'Bearer timeline-ig-access:timeline-ig-account-b',
    body: JSON.stringify({ recipient: { id: 'timeline-ig-peer' }, message: { text: 'rejeitada sem credencial da conta' } }),
  });
  expect(rejectedSend.status()).toBe(403);
  const after = await (await fixtureGet(request, '/provider/instagram/state')).json();
  expect(after.calls).toEqual(before.calls);
  expect(after.effects).toEqual(before.effects);
}

async function hold(request: APIRequestContext, conversationId: string) {
  const response = await request.post(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/hold`, { data: { conversationId } });
  expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
}

async function waitForNativeHold(request: APIRequestContext) {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 200; attempt += 1) {
    const response = await request.get(`${FRONTDOOR}/__test/fcr/state`);
    expect(response.status()).toBe(200);
    const state = await response.json();
    if (state.pending) return state.pending as { status: number; bodyHash: string; bodyBytes: number; headers: Record<string, string> };
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 25));
  }
  throw new Error('The native HTTPS proxy did not hold the completed BFF response.');
}

## FULL SOURCE web-app/src/api.spec.ts

```
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { ErroDaApi, api, inboxApi } from './api';

function responde(corpo: string, init: { status?: number; ok?: boolean } = {}) {
  const status = init.status ?? 200;
  vi.stubGlobal(
    'fetch',
    vi.fn(async () => ({
      status,
      ok: init.ok ?? status < 400,
      text: async () => corpo,
    })),
  );
}

afterEach(() => vi.unstubAllGlobals());

describe('resposta que não é JSON (api.ts)', () => {
  it('falha DIZENDO a causa provável, em vez de devolver objeto vazio', async () => {
    // O que o nginx do próprio front devolve quando a base da API está vazia.
    responde('<!doctype html><html><body><div id="root"></div></body></html>');

    await expect(api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/base da API está VAZIA/);
    await expect(api.get('/painel')).rejects.toMatchObject({ codigo: 'RESPOSTA_NAO_E_JSON' });
  });

  it('a mensagem aponta para LEADSHUG_API_URL quando a base está vazia', async () => {
    responde('<html></html>');
    await expect(api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/LEADSHUG_API_URL/);
  });

  it('corpo vazio com 200 continua sendo objeto vazio — isso é legítimo', async () => {
    responde('');
    await expect(api.get('/x')).resolves.toEqual({});
  });

  /**
   * Com a base CONFIGURADA — o cenário do stage.
   *
   * `API_BASE` é lida na importação do módulo, então o `window` precisa existir
   * ANTES dela. Importar de novo com `resetModules` é o que faz este teste
   * exercitar o caminho de verdade, e não o de base vazia.
   */
  async function comBase(url: string) {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.stubGlobal('window', { __LEADSHUG__: { apiUrl: url } });
    return (await import('./api')) as typeof import('./api');
  }

  it('405 é reconhecido como servidor de ARQUIVOS, não como "API confusa"', async () => {
    // nginx responde 405 a um POST para arquivo estático. É assinatura, não
    // ambiguidade — e dizer isso poupa uma rodada de investigação.
    const mod = await comBase('https://api.exemplo.com.br');
    responde('<html>405</html>', { status: 405 });

    await expect(mod.api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow(/servidor de ARQUIVOS/);
    await expect(mod.api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow(/LEADSHUG_API_URL/);
  });

  it('HTML com 200 também é reconhecido como servidor de arquivos', async () => {
    const mod = await comBase('https://api.exemplo.com.br');
    responde('<!doctype html><html></html>');
    await expect(mod.api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/servidor de ARQUIVOS/);
  });

  it('resposta não-JSON que NÃO parece estática cai na mensagem genérica', async () => {
    const mod = await comBase('https://api.exemplo.com.br');
    responde('isto não é json nem html', { status: 502 });
    await expect(mod.api.get('/painel')).rejects.toThrow(/não é JSON/);
  });

  it('JSON válido passa como sempre', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ atendimento: { emEspera: 3 } }));
    await expect(api.get('/painel')).resolves.toEqual({ atendimento: { emEspera: 3 } });
  });
});

describe('contrato de resposta V2', () => {
  it('envia somente o payload versionado com a rota e a geração capturadas', async () => {
    const request: { current: { url: string; init?: RequestInit } | null } = { current: null };
    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(async (url: string, init?: RequestInit) => {
      request.current = { url, init };
      return { status: 201, ok: true, text: async () => JSON.stringify({ id: 'message-1', canal: 'INSTAGRAM', em: '2026-10-25T10:00:00.000Z' }) };
    }));
    const body = { texto: 'Olá', schemaVersion: 2 as const, routeId: '11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111',
      channelId: '22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222', expectedGeneration: 3, contextFingerprint: 'a'.repeat(64) };
    await inboxApi.reply('33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333', body);
    expect(request.current?.url).toContain('/conversations/33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333/messages');
    expect(JSON.parse(String(request.current?.init?.body))).toEqual(body);
    expect(request.current?.init?.headers).toMatchObject({ 'x-requested-with': 'leadshug-web' });
  });
});

describe('base sem esquema (o erro de stage)', () => {
  it('recusa host solto: sem esquema, o navegador trata como CAMINHO', async () => {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.stubGlobal('window', { __LEADSHUG__: { apiUrl: 'leadshug-api-stage.up.railway.app' } });
    // A chamada viraria https://<o-proprio-front>/leadshug-api-stage.../api/bff/...
    // e bateria no nginx do front — 405 no login, sem nada citando a variável.
    await expect(import('./api')).rejects.toThrow(/sem esquema/);
  });

  it('aceita https e http', async () => {
    vi.resetModules();
    vi.stubGlobal('window', { __LEADSHUG__: { apiUrl: 'https://api.exemplo.com.br' } });
    await expect(import('./api')).resolves.toBeDefined();
  });
});

describe('falha do servidor (o 500 do Nest)', () => {
  it('usa `message` quando não há `error`, e SEMPRE mostra o status', async () => {
    // Formato do 500 do Nest. Antes, isto virava "Falha inesperada." — que não
    // dizia nem que era 500.
    responde(JSON.stringify({ statusCode: 500, message: 'Internal server error' }), { status: 500 });
    await expect(api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow('Internal server error (HTTP 500)');
  });

  it('sem `error` e sem `message`, diz o status mesmo assim', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ statusCode: 502 }), { status: 502 });
    await expect(api.get('/x')).rejects.toThrow(/respondeu 502 sem explicar/);
  });

  it('recusa do produto continua mostrando a mensagem do produto', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ error: 'E-mail ou senha inválidos.', code: 'CREDENCIAL_INVALIDA' }), { status: 401 });
    await expect(api.post('/auth/login', {})).rejects.toThrow(/E-mail ou senha inválidos/);
  });

  it('retém outcome e metadados seguros de incerteza', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({
      error: 'O envio não foi confirmado.', code: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
      outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID',
      localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED',
    }), { status: 503 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/messages', { texto: 'draft' })).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'OUTBOUND_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE', outcome: 'ACCEPTED_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
      evidence: 'ACK_WITHOUT_ID', localMessageState: 'UNCONFIRMED', diagnosticPersistence: 'UNCONFIRMED',
    });
  });
});

describe('incerteza local segura em operação de modelo', () => {
  it('preserva operationId e certeza de ACK sem copiar metadados arbitrários', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({
      code: 'TEMPLATE_SUBMISSION_LOCAL_INCOMPLETE',
      operationId: 'f01ba7da-8869-4f97-a7d4-c68cc057d765',

      phase: 'ACCEPTED', providerAcceptance: 'CONFIRMED',
      acceptanceProvenance: 'ACKNOWLEDGED', receiptPersistence: 'RECORDED',
    });
  });
});

describe('metadados permitidos para recuperação do primeiro envio', () => {
  it('preserva tentativa, estado e prazo sem copiar metadados não permitidos', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({
      code: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: '31a2a504-7c8f-4b8e-9fc7-c3f1c2c2d112',
      state: 'AMBIGUOUS', eligibleAt: '2026-10-22T14:00:00.000Z', credential: 'must-not-be-copied',
    }), { status: 409 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/initial-messages', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: '31a2a504-7c8f-4b8e-9fc7-c3f1c2c2d112',
      state: 'AMBIGUOUS', eligibleAt: '2026-10-22T14:00:00.000Z',
    });
  });

  it('preserva apenas o sinal booleano de recusa comprovada antes da reserva', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ code: 'PREVIEW_CONTEXT_CHANGED', preAdmission: true, ownerNonce: 'never-project' }), { status: 409 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/initial-messages', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'PREVIEW_CONTEXT_CHANGED', preAdmission: true,
    });
    responde(JSON.stringify({ code: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', preAdmission: 'true' }), { status: 409 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/initial-messages', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', preAdmission: undefined,

  it('descarta IDs, estados e prazos fora da allowlist/tipo', async () => {
    responde(JSON.stringify({ code: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: '../../private', state: 'ownerNonce', eligibleAt: 'yesterday' }), { status: 409 });
    await expect(api.post('/conversations/c1/initial-messages', {})).rejects.toMatchObject({
      codigo: 'INITIAL_SEND_UNCERTAIN', attemptId: undefined, state: undefined, eligibleAt: undefined,
    });
  });

## FULL SOURCE web-app/src/api.ts

```
/**
 * Cliente do BFF.
 *
 * O front é serviço próprio, num SUBDOMÍNIO do mesmo domínio da API (ADR-0015).
 * Isso é origem diferente e **mesmo site** — então:
 *  - `credentials: 'include'` manda o cookie `HttpOnly` para a API;
 *  - o cookie continua `SameSite=Lax`, porque subdomínio é o mesmo site;
 *  - `X-Requested-With` é exigido pelo servidor no que muda estado (CSRF).
 *
 * A base da API vem de `/config.js`, escrito pelo container no START — não do
 * build (ver `config.ts`). Vazio = mesma origem.
 */
import { API_BASE as BASE } from './config';
/** Evento disparado quando qualquer chamada volta 401. */
export const SESSAO_MORTA = 'leadshug:sessao-morta';

/**
 * A conta ainda não terminou o wizard (409 ONBOARDING_PENDENTE), ou um módulo
 * foi desligado com a aba aberta (404 MODULO_DESLIGADO).
 *
 * Nos dois casos o estado da tela está VELHO, não errado: o app rebusca o /me e
 * se remonta, em vez de mostrar erro. É o mesmo padrão do SESSAO_MORTA.
 */
export const PRODUTO_MUDOU = 'leadshug:produto-mudou';

/**
 * `typeof window` porque este módulo também é exercitado fora do navegador —
 * é o teste de unidade que prova isso. Estourar aqui trocaria o erro REAL da
 * chamada por um "window is not defined", que aponta para o lugar errado.
 */
function avisar(evento: string): void {
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(evento));
}

export class ErroDaApi extends Error {
  constructor(
    readonly status: number,
    readonly codigo: string | undefined,
    mensagem: string,
    readonly outcome?: string,
    readonly evidence?: string,
    readonly localMessageState?: string,
    readonly diagnosticPersistence?: string,
    readonly operationId?: string,
    readonly phase?: string,
    readonly providerAcceptance?: string,
    readonly receiptPersistence?: string,
    readonly acceptanceProvenance?: string,
    readonly recoveryAction?: string,
    readonly attemptId?: string,
    readonly state?: string,
    readonly eligibleAt?: string,
    readonly preAdmission?: boolean,
  ) {
    super(mensagem);
  }
}

async function chamar<T>(caminho: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  const mudaEstado = Boolean(init.method && init.method !== 'GET');
  const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/api/bff${caminho}`, {
    ...init,
    credentials: 'include',
    headers: {
      'content-type': 'application/json',
      ...(mudaEstado ? { 'x-requested-with': 'leadshug-web' } : {}),
      ...(init.headers ?? {}),
    },
  });

  if (res.status === 204) return undefined as T;

  // Resposta que NÃO é JSON é falha de configuração, não corpo vazio.
  //
  // O caso real: sem `LEADSHUG_API_URL`, a base fica vazia e o front chama a
  // PRÓPRIA origem — onde o nginx serve o index.html para qualquer caminho. A
  // resposta vem 200, com HTML. Engolir isso como `{}` fazia a tela quebrar três
  // passos depois, num campo que não tem relação nenhuma com a causa
  // ("Cannot read properties of undefined"), e mandava quem depura para o lugar
  // errado. Falhar aqui, dizendo o que provavelmente está errado, é o mínimo.
  const bruto = await res.text();
  let corpo: Record<string, unknown>;
  try {
    corpo = bruto ? JSON.parse(bruto) : {};
  } catch {
    // 405 num POST é assinatura de SERVIDOR DE ARQUIVOS: nginx responde assim
    // quando recebe POST para um arquivo estático. Dizer isso poupa a rodada de
    // "confira se é mesmo a API" — o que responde não é uma API.
    const pareceEstatico = res.status === 405 || /^\s*<(!doctype|html)/i.test(bruto);

    throw new ErroDaApi(
      res.status,
      'RESPOSTA_NAO_E_JSON',
      !BASE
        ? 'A base da API está VAZIA: o front está chamando a própria origem. ' +
          'Configure LEADSHUG_API_URL no serviço web.'
        : pareceEstatico
          ? `${BASE} respondeu ${res.status} como um servidor de ARQUIVOS, não como a API ` +
            `(em ${caminho}). Esse endereço aponta para o serviço errado — confira ` +
            'LEADSHUG_API_URL e o domínio do serviço `api`.'
          : `A API respondeu ${res.status} com algo que não é JSON em ${caminho}. ` +
            `Confira se ${BASE} é mesmo a API.`,
    );
  }

  if (res.status === 401) {
    // A sessão morreu (expirou, a conta foi inativada, a senha foi resetada).
    // Quem descobre isso é qualquer chamada, então o aviso é central: a tela
    // que estava aberta não tem como saber o que fazer sozinha.
    avisar(SESSAO_MORTA);
  }
  // Estado VELHO, não erro: a conta não terminou o wizard, ou um módulo foi
  // desligado com esta aba aberta. O app rebusca o /me e se remonta.
  if (corpo.code === 'ONBOARDING_PENDENTE' || corpo.code === 'MODULO_DESLIGADO') {
    avisar(PRODUTO_MUDOU);
  }
  if (!res.ok) {
    // `error` é o campo das recusas do produto. Um 500 do Nest NÃO tem esse
    // campo — ele traz `message` —, e ignorá-lo transformava toda falha de
    // servidor em "Falha inesperada.", que não diz nem o status. O status entra
    // sempre: é o primeiro dado que quem depura precisa.
    const dito = corpo.error ?? corpo.message;
    throw new ErroDaApi(
      res.status,
      typeof corpo.code === 'string' ? corpo.code : undefined,
      dito ? `${dito} (HTTP ${res.status})` : `A API respondeu ${res.status} sem explicar o motivo.`,
      typeof corpo.outcome === 'string' ? corpo.outcome : undefined,
      typeof corpo.evidence === 'string' ? corpo.evidence : undefined,
      typeof corpo.localMessageState === 'string' ? corpo.localMessageState : undefined,
      typeof corpo.diagnosticPersistence === 'string' ? corpo.diagnosticPersistence : undefined,
      typeof corpo.operationId === 'string' ? corpo.operationId : undefined,
      typeof corpo.phase === 'string' ? corpo.phase : undefined,
      typeof corpo.providerAcceptance === 'string' ? corpo.providerAcceptance : undefined,
      typeof corpo.receiptPersistence === 'string' ? corpo.receiptPersistence : undefined,
      typeof corpo.acceptanceProvenance === 'string' ? corpo.acceptanceProvenance : undefined,
      typeof corpo.recoveryAction === 'string' ? corpo.recoveryAction : undefined,
      typeof corpo.attemptId === 'string' && /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(corpo.attemptId) ? corpo.attemptId : undefined,
      typeof corpo.state === 'string' && ['PREPARED', 'SENDING', 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED', 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED_LOCAL_BLOCKED', 'SUCCEEDED', 'AMBIGUOUS', 'REJECTED'].includes(corpo.state) ? corpo.state : undefined,
      typeof corpo.eligibleAt === 'string' && corpo.eligibleAt.length <= 40 && Number.isFinite(Date.parse(corpo.eligibleAt)) ? corpo.eligibleAt : undefined,
      corpo.preAdmission === true ? true : undefined,
    );
  }
  return corpo as T;
}

/**
 * Trata a falha de uma chamada disparada e esquecida (carregamento de tela).
 *
 * 401 aqui é normal e não é problema da tela: a sessão morreu — no logout, por
 * expiração, ou porque a conta foi inativada — e quem redireciona é o App. Sem
 * este filtro, cada chamada em voo no momento do logout vira uma **rejeição não
 * tratada**, que o navegador registra como exceção da página. Foi assim que o
 * teste de navegador pegou o primeiro defeito real.
 */
export function ignorarSessaoMorta(e: unknown): void {
  if (e instanceof ErroDaApi && e.status === 401) return;
  // Tratados centralmente pelo App, que rebusca o /me e remonta. Deixá-los
  // chegar ao console faria a tela reclamar de algo que já está sendo resolvido.
  if (e instanceof ErroDaApi && (e.codigo === 'ONBOARDING_PENDENTE' || e.codigo === 'MODULO_DESLIGADO')) return;
  console.error(e);
}

export const api = {
  get: <T>(c: string) => chamar<T>(c),
  post: <T>(c: string, corpo?: unknown) =>
    chamar<T>(c, { method: 'POST', body: corpo ? JSON.stringify(corpo) : undefined }),
  postWithHeaders: <T>(c: string, corpo: unknown, headers: Record<string, string>) =>
    chamar<T>(c, { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify(corpo), headers }),
  patch: <T>(c: string, corpo?: unknown) =>
    chamar<T>(c, { method: 'PATCH', body: corpo ? JSON.stringify(corpo) : undefined }),
  put: <T>(c: string, corpo?: unknown) =>
    chamar<T>(c, { method: 'PUT', body: corpo ? JSON.stringify(corpo) : undefined }),
  del: <T>(c: string) => chamar<T>(c, { method: 'DELETE' }),

  /**
   * Envia um arquivo (ADR-0024). Sem `content-type`: o navegador precisa montar
   * o `boundary` do multipart sozinho, e declará-lo à mão quebra o parse no
   * servidor de um jeito que não diz o que houve.
   */
  async enviarArquivo(arquivo: File): Promise<{ id: string; tipo: string }> {
    const corpo = new FormData();
    corpo.append('arquivo', arquivo);
    const res = await fetch(`${BASE}/api/bff/arquivos`, {
      method: 'POST',
      credentials: 'include',
      headers: { 'x-requested-with': 'leadshug-web' },
      body: corpo,
    });
    const bruto = await res.text();
    let json: Record<string, string> = {};
    try {
      json = bruto ? JSON.parse(bruto) : {};
    } catch {
      throw new ErroDaApi(res.status, 'RESPOSTA_NAO_E_JSON', 'A API respondeu algo que não é JSON.');
    }
    if (!res.ok) throw new ErroDaApi(res.status, json.code, json.error ?? 'Falha ao enviar o arquivo.');
    return json as unknown as { id: string; tipo: string };
  },
};

/** O endereço de leitura de um arquivo guardado — passa pela sessão. */
export function urlDoArquivo(id: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  return id ? `${BASE}/api/bff/arquivos/${id}` : null;
}

  CapacidadesNumero, ChaveIdempotenciaReserva, ConfirmacaoNumeroResponse, chaveIdempotenciaReserva,
  mensagemErroCadastro, motivoCapacidade, nomeConexaoProvedor, nomeEstadoTentativa, OpcoesMeta,

  interface Window {
    FB?: {
      init(options: { appId: string; version: string; xfbml?: boolean }): void;
      login(callback: (response: FbLoginResponse) => void, options: Record<string, unknown>): void;
    };

}
interface FbLoginResponse { authResponse?: { code?: string }; status?: string }
interface PairResponse { channelId: string; attemptId: string | null; generation: number; pairingEpoch: number; state: string; qrcode: string | null }
interface VerificationResponse { status: string; ownNumberVerified: boolean; receiptVerified: boolean }
interface QrTemporario {
  value: string; buId: string; channelId: string; attemptId: string; generation: number; pairingEpoch: number;
