```
    const navigation = navigationIntent.current;
    const intent = ++startOptionsIntent.current;
    const ownOptionsError = erroOpcoesAlerta.current;
    const stillCurrent = () => mounted.current && intent === startOptionsIntent.current
      && actor === actorAtual.current && generation === geracao.current && navigation === navigationIntent.current
      && id === conversaAtual.current && bu === buAtual.current;
    void api.get<StartOptions>(`/conversations/${id}/start-options`).then((result) => {
      if (!stillCurrent()) return;
      setStartOptions(result);
      setStartOptionsFor(id);
      setStartOptionsError(null);
      limparErroOpcoes(actor, bu, id, generation, navigation, ownOptionsError);
    }).catch(() => {
      // Keep the current error and all composer state until another real reconnect.
      if (!stillCurrent()) return;
      startOptionsErrorReconnectEpoch.current = metadataReconnectEpoch;
    });
  }, [metadataReconnectEpoch, startOptionsError, aberta?.conversa.id, buId, eu.id, limparErroOpcoes]);

  useEffect(() => {
    void carregarLista().catch(ignorarSessaoMorta);
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      void carregarLista().catch(ignorarSessaoMorta);
      if (recuperacao.current) iniciarRodadaAutorizada();
      else reconciliar();
    }, 60_000);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [buId, aba, carregarLista, reconciliar, iniciarRodadaAutorizada]);

  useEffect(() => {
    // Espera a lista inicial de BUs e mantém o socket apesar de filtros, BUs ou
    // callbacks locais mudarem. Isso evita reconectar durante o mesmo login.
    if (bus.length === 0) return;
    const actor = eu.id;
    const parar = ouvirTempoReal((evento) => {
      if (actor !== actorAtual.current) return;
      if (evento.buId !== buAtual.current) return;
      void carregarListaRef.current().catch(ignorarSessaoMorta);
      if (evento.conversaId === conversaAtual.current) reconciliarRef.current();
    }, () => { setMetadataReconnectEpoch((value) => value + 1); reconciliarRef.current(); });
    return parar;
  }, [eu.id, bus.length]);

  function trocarBu(novoBu: string) {
    geracao.current += 1;
    navigationIntent.current += 1;
    ++listaIntent.current;
    buAtual.current = novoBu;
    conversaAtual.current = null;
    recuperacao.current = null;
    invalidacaoAbertura.current = null;
    guardarThread(null);
    setAbrindo(false);
    setCarregandoAnteriores(false);
    definirErro(null);
    setAlertaAtual(null);
    setRecuperacaoPendente(false);
    setConversas([]);
    setStartOptions(null);
    setStartOptionsFor(null);
    setStartOptionsError(null);
    setManualInitialConversationId(null);
    setBuId(novoBu);
  }

  async function abrir(id: string, marcarLida = true) {
    const gen = ++geracao.current;
    const nav = ++navigationIntent.current;
    const actor = eu.id;
    conversaAtual.current = id;
    recuperacao.current = null;
    invalidacaoAbertura.current = { id, geracao: gen, eventos: 0 };
    versaoMetadados.current += 1;
    guardarThread(null);
    setAbrindo(true);
    setCarregandoAnteriores(false);
    definirErro(null);
    setAlertaAtual(null);
    setRecuperacaoPendente(false);
    try {
      const response = await api.get<Thread>(`/conversations/${id}/messages?marcarLida=${marcarLida}`);
      if (actor !== actorAtual.current || gen !== geracao.current || nav !== navigationIntent.current || conversaAtual.current !== id) return;
      response.messages = mesclarMensagens(response.messages);
      guardarThread(response);
      setAbrindo(false);
      const invalidacao = invalidacaoAbertura.current;
      invalidacaoAbertura.current = null;
      void carregarLista().catch(ignorarSessaoMorta);
      if (invalidacao?.id === id && invalidacao.geracao === gen && invalidacao.eventos > 0) reconciliar();
    } catch (e) {
      if (actor === actorAtual.current && gen === geracao.current && nav === navigationIntent.current) {
        invalidacaoAbertura.current = null;
        guardarThread(null);
        setAbrindo(false);
        definirErro(e instanceof ErroDaApi && e.status === 404 ? 'Acesso à conversa perdido.' : 'Não foi possível carregar a conversa.');
      }
    }
  }

  async function carregarAnteriores() {
    const atual = threadAtual.current;
    const id = conversaAtual.current;
    const cursor = atual?.paginacao.cursorAnterior;
    if (!atual || !id || !cursor || carregandoAnteriores) return;
    const gen = geracao.current;
    const actor = eu.id;
    setCarregandoAnteriores(true);
    definirErro(null);
    try {
      const pagina = await api.get<Thread>(`/conversations/${id}/messages?antes=${encodeURIComponent(cursor)}`);
      if (actor !== actorAtual.current || gen !== geracao.current || id !== conversaAtual.current || !threadAtual.current) return;
      // Inclua alterações legítimas que chegaram enquanto a página estava no ar.
      const alturaAntes = bolhas.current?.scrollHeight ?? 0;
      const topoAntes = bolhas.current?.scrollTop ?? 0;
      const corrente = threadAtual.current;
      guardarThread({ ...corrente, messages: mesclarMensagens(corrente.messages, pagina.messages), paginacao: pagina.paginacao });
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        if (actor === actorAtual.current && gen === geracao.current && bolhas.current) bolhas.current.scrollTop = topoAntes + (bolhas.current.scrollHeight - alturaAntes);
      });
    } catch (e) {
      if (actor === actorAtual.current && gen === geracao.current) definirErro(e instanceof ErroDaApi && e.status === 404 ? 'Acesso à conversa perdido.' : 'Falha ao carregar mensagens anteriores.');
    } finally {
      if (actor === actorAtual.current && gen === geracao.current) setCarregandoAnteriores(false);
    }
  }

  async function agir(acao: () => Promise<unknown>) {
    const id = conversaAtual.current;
    const gen = geracao.current;
    const actor = eu.id;
    if (!id) return;
    versaoMetadados.current += 1;
    definirErro(null);
    try {
      await acao();
      if (actor !== actorAtual.current || gen !== geracao.current || id !== conversaAtual.current) return;
      void carregarLista().catch(ignorarSessaoMorta);
      reconciliar();
    } catch (e) {
      if (actor === actorAtual.current && gen === geracao.current) definirErro(e instanceof ErroDaApi ? e.message : 'Falhou.');
    }
  }

  const envioIndisponivel = aberta ? !aberta.janela.disponivel : false;
  const janelaFechada = aberta?.janela.exigida && !aberta.janela.aberta;
  const currentStartOptions = aberta && startOptionsFor === aberta.conversa.id ? startOptions : null;
  const ordinaryUncertainAdmission = currentStartOptions?.ordinaryAdmissions.find((item) => ['SENDING', 'UNCERTAIN'].includes(item.state)) ?? null;
  const activeOrdinaryAdmission = Boolean(ordinaryUncertainAdmission);
  const requiresInitialFlow = Boolean(aberta && (currentStartOptions?.activeAttempt
    || (aberta.messages.length === 0 && currentStartOptions?.initialRecipientPlatform === 'WHATSAPP')
    || manualInitialConversationId === aberta.conversa.id));
  const startOptionsLoading = Boolean(aberta && startOptionsFor !== aberta.conversa.id);
  const isInstagramConversation = aberta?.conversa.display?.platform === 'INSTAGRAM';
  const activeConversationId = aberta?.conversa.id;
  const activeGeneration = geracao.current;
  const activeNavigation = navigationIntent.current;
  const actorAtRender = eu.id;
  const receiveOptions = (id: string, generationAtRender: number, navigationAtRender: number, result: StartOptions) => {
    if (actorAtRender === actorAtual.current && id === conversaAtual.current && generationAtRender === geracao.current && navigationAtRender === navigationIntent.current && buId === buAtual.current) {
      ++startOptionsIntent.current;
      const ownOptionsError = erroOpcoesAlerta.current;
      setStartOptions(result); setStartOptionsFor(id); setStartOptionsError(null);
      limparErroOpcoes(actorAtRender, buId, id, generationAtRender, navigationAtRender, ownOptionsError);
    }
  };
  const refreshOrdinaryOptions = async (id: string, generationAtRender: number, buAtRender: string, navigationAtRender: number) => {
    const actor = eu.id;
    const intent = ++startOptionsIntent.current;
    const ownOptionsError = erroOpcoesAlerta.current;
    const result = await api.get<StartOptions>(`/conversations/${id}/start-options`);
    if (intent === startOptionsIntent.current && actor === actorAtual.current && id === conversaAtual.current && navigationAtRender === navigationIntent.current && generationAtRender === geracao.current && buAtRender === buAtual.current) {
      setStartOptions(result); setStartOptionsFor(id); setStartOptionsError(null);
      limparErroOpcoes(actor, buAtRender, id, generationAtRender, navigationAtRender, ownOptionsError);
    }
  };
  const completeInitial = (id: string, generationAtRender: number, navigationAtRender: number) => {
    if (actorAtRender !== actorAtual.current || id !== conversaAtual.current || generationAtRender !== geracao.current || navigationAtRender !== navigationIntent.current) return;
    setManualInitialConversationId(null);
    void abrir(id, false);
  };
  const novaConversationActor = eu.id;
  const novaConversationBu = buId;
  const novaConversationGeneration = geracao.current;
  const novaConversationNavigation = navigationIntent.current;

  if (actorForState.current !== eu.id) return <div className="grade"><p className="suave" role="status">Carregando conversas do usuário atual…</p></div>;

  return (
    <div className="grade">
      <div className="linha">
        <select aria-label="Business Unit" value={buId} onChange={(e) => trocarBu(e.target.value)} style={{ maxWidth: 280 }}>
          {bus.map((b) => <option key={b.id} value={b.id}>{b.name}</option>)}
        </select>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => setNovaConversa(true)} disabled={!buId}>Nova conversa</button>
        {alertaAtual && <span className="erro" role="alert" data-alert-version={alertaAtual.version}>{alertaAtual.message}</span>}
      </div>

      {novaConversa && <NovaConversa key={`${novaConversationActor}:${novaConversationBu}:${novaConversationGeneration}:${novaConversationNavigation}`} buId={buId} onAlert={publicarAlerta} onClearAlert={limparAlerta} onClose={() => {
        if (novaConversationActor === actorAtual.current && novaConversationBu === buAtual.current && novaConversationGeneration === geracao.current && novaConversationNavigation === navigationIntent.current) setNovaConversa(false);
      }} onOpened={(result) => {
        if (novaConversationActor !== actorAtual.current || novaConversationBu !== buAtual.current || novaConversationGeneration !== geracao.current || novaConversationNavigation !== navigationIntent.current) return;
        setNovaConversa(false);
        setManualInitialConversationId(result.conversaId);
        void carregarLista().catch(ignorarSessaoMorta);
        void abrir(result.conversaId, false);
      }} />}

      <div className="abas">
        {ABAS.map((a) => <button key={a.id} className={aba === a.id ? 'ativa' : ''} onClick={() => { navigationIntent.current += 1; abaAtual.current = a.id; setAba(a.id); }}>{a.rotulo}</button>)}
      </div>

      <div className="inbox">
        <div className="cartao lista" style={{ padding: 0 }}>
          {conversas.map((c) => <button key={c.id} className={`item ${aberta?.conversa.id === c.id ? 'ativo' : ''}`} aria-label={`${c.display?.recipientLabel || 'Contato'} ${c.attendantName ?? 'sem atendente'} · ${rotuloDaConta(c.display)}`} onClick={() => { setManualInitialConversationId(null); void abrir(c.id); }}>
            <div className="linha"><strong>{c.display?.recipientLabel || 'Contato'}</strong>{c.unreadCount > 0 && <span className="suave">({c.unreadCount})</span>}</div>
            <div className="suave">{rotuloDaConta(c.display)}</div>
            <div className="suave">{c.attendantName ?? 'sem atendente'}</div>
          </button>)}
          {conversas.length === 0 && <p className="suave" style={{ padding: 12 }}>Nada aqui.</p>}
        </div>

        <div className="cartao grade">
          {!aberta && (abrindo
            ? <p className="suave" role="status" aria-live="polite">Abrindo conversa…</p>
            : <p className="suave">Escolha uma conversa.</p>)}
          {aberta && <>
            <div className="linha">
              <strong>{aberta.conversa.display?.recipientLabel || 'Contato'}</strong>
              <span className="suave">{aberta.conversa.status}</span>
              <span className="suave" style={{ marginLeft: 'auto' }}>{rotuloDaConta(aberta.conversa.display)}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="linha">
              {aberta.paginacao.temAnteriores
                ? <button onClick={() => void carregarAnteriores()} disabled={carregandoAnteriores} aria-label="Carregar mensagens anteriores">
                    {carregandoAnteriores ? 'Carregando…' : 'Carregar anteriores'}
                  </button>
                : <span className="suave">Início do histórico</span>}
              {recuperacaoPendente && <span className="suave" role="status">Atualização pendente. O histórico pode ter uma lacuna.</span>}
              {recuperacaoPendente && <button onClick={() => iniciarRodadaAutorizada()}>Continuar atualização</button>}
            </div>
            <div className="bolhas" ref={bolhas} aria-live="polite">
              {aberta.messages.map((m: Mensagem) => <div key={m.id} data-message-id={m.id} className={`bolha ${m.direction === 'OUT' ? 'saiu' : ''}`}>
                <div>{m.content}</div>
                <div className="suave">{new Date(m.createdAt).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}{m.authorName ? ` · ${m.authorName}` : ''}</div>
              </div>)}
              {aberta.messages.length === 0 && <p className="suave">Nenhuma mensagem nesta conversa.</p>}
            </div>

            {envioIndisponivel && <div className="aviso" role="status">{janelaFechada
              ? 'Fora da janela de 24h do canal selecionado. Texto livre está indisponível.'
              : explicarMotivoEnvio(aberta.janela.motivo)}</div>}
            {requiresInitialFlow && activeConversationId && <InstagramDraftReview actorId={eu.id} buId={buId} conversationId={activeConversationId} />}
            {activeOrdinaryAdmission && !currentStartOptions?.activeAttempt && aberta.messages.length > 0
              ? <>
                <InstagramReplyComposer key={`${eu.id}:${buId}:${activeConversationId}:${activeGeneration}:${activeNavigation}`} actorId={eu.id} buId={buId} conversationId={activeConversationId!} admissionBlocked metadataReconnectEpoch={metadataReconnectEpoch} onAlert={publicarAlerta} onClearAlert={limparAlerta} onOutcomeNeedsReview={() => refreshOrdinaryOptions(activeConversationId!, activeGeneration, buId, activeNavigation)} onSent={() => {
                  if (actorAtRender === actorAtual.current && activeGeneration === geracao.current && activeNavigation === navigationIntent.current && activeConversationId === conversaAtual.current) {
                    void carregarLista().catch(ignorarSessaoMorta);
                    reconciliar();
                  }
                }} />
                <OrdinaryRecovery key={`ordinary-recovery:${eu.id}:${buId}:${aberta.conversa.id}:${activeGeneration}:${activeNavigation}`} conversationId={aberta.conversa.id} admission={ordinaryUncertainAdmission!} onAlert={publicarAlerta} onClearAlert={limparAlerta} onOptions={(result) => receiveOptions(aberta.conversa.id, activeGeneration, activeNavigation, result)} />
              </>
              : (aberta.messages.length === 0 && startOptionsLoading
                ? <p className="suave" role="status">Conferindo opções do primeiro envio…</p>
                : ((requiresInitialFlow && !startOptionsLoading && currentStartOptions?.initialRecipientPlatform !== 'WHATSAPP')
                  || (aberta.messages.length === 0 && !currentStartOptions?.activeAttempt && !activeOrdinaryAdmission && currentStartOptions?.initialRecipientPlatform !== 'WHATSAPP'))
              ? <span className="suave" role="status">{isInstagramConversation
                ? 'Esta conversa do Instagram só permite responder a uma mensagem recebida.'
                : 'O destinatário não tem uma rota WhatsApp canônica confirmada. Não é possível iniciar um envio.'}</span>
              : requiresInitialFlow
              ? startOptionsLoading
                ? <p className="suave" role="status">Conferindo opções do primeiro envio…</p>
                : currentStartOptions
                  ? ordinaryUncertainAdmission && !currentStartOptions.activeAttempt
                    ? <OrdinaryRecovery key={`ordinary-recovery:${eu.id}:${buId}:${aberta.conversa.id}:${activeGeneration}:${activeNavigation}`} conversationId={aberta.conversa.id} admission={ordinaryUncertainAdmission} onAlert={publicarAlerta} onClearAlert={limparAlerta} onOptions={(result) => receiveOptions(aberta.conversa.id, activeGeneration, activeNavigation, result)} />
                    : <PrimeiraMensagem key={`${eu.id}:${buId}:${aberta.conversa.id}:${activeGeneration}:${activeNavigation}`} actorId={eu.id} buId={buId} conversationId={aberta.conversa.id} onAlert={publicarAlerta} onClearAlert={limparAlerta}
                      options={currentStartOptions} onOptions={(result) => receiveOptions(aberta.conversa.id, activeGeneration, activeNavigation, result)} onComplete={() => completeInitial(aberta.conversa.id, activeGeneration, activeNavigation)} onCancel={aberta.messages.length > 0 ? () => { if (activeGeneration === geracao.current && activeNavigation === navigationIntent.current) setManualInitialConversationId(null); } : undefined} />
                  : <span role="status" className="suave">{startOptionsError ?? 'Não foi possível conferir se existe uma operação ativa.'}</span>
              : startOptionsLoading
                ? <p className="suave" role="status">Conferindo se há um envio inicial pendente…</p>
                : activeConversationId && <><InstagramReplyComposer key={`${eu.id}:${buId}:${activeConversationId}:${activeGeneration}:${activeNavigation}`} actorId={eu.id} buId={buId} conversationId={activeConversationId} metadataReconnectEpoch={metadataReconnectEpoch} onAlert={publicarAlerta} onClearAlert={limparAlerta} onOutcomeNeedsReview={() => refreshOrdinaryOptions(activeConversationId, activeGeneration, buId, activeNavigation)} onSent={() => {
                    if (actorAtRender === actorAtual.current && activeGeneration === geracao.current && activeNavigation === navigationIntent.current && activeConversationId === conversaAtual.current) {
                      void carregarLista().catch(ignorarSessaoMorta);
                      reconciliar();
                    }
                  }} />{activeOrdinaryAdmission && ordinaryUncertainAdmission && <OrdinaryRecovery key={`ordinary-recovery:${eu.id}:${buId}:${aberta.conversa.id}:${activeGeneration}:${activeNavigation}`} conversationId={aberta.conversa.id} admission={ordinaryUncertainAdmission} onAlert={publicarAlerta} onClearAlert={limparAlerta} onOptions={(result) => receiveOptions(aberta.conversa.id, activeGeneration, activeNavigation, result)} />}</>)}
            {aberta.conversa.status !== 'CLOSED' && <div className="linha">
              <button onClick={() => void agir(() => api.post(`/conversations/${aberta.conversa.id}/claim`))}>Atender</button>
              <button onClick={() => void agir(() => api.post(`/conversations/${aberta.conversa.id}/close`))}>Finalizar</button>
            </div>}
          </>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { BusinessUnit, Eu, api, ignorarSessaoMorta } from '../api';
import CadastroNumero from '../componentes/CadastroNumero';
import InstagramConnections from '../componentes/InstagramConnections';

export default function Numeros({ eu }: { eu: Eu }) {
  const [bus, setBus] = useState<BusinessUnit[]>([]);
  const [erro, setErro] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const generation = useRef(0);
  const actorAtual = useRef(eu.id);
  actorAtual.current = eu.id;
  const actorDono = useRef(eu.id);
  const request = useRef<{ actorId: string; promise: Promise<BusinessUnit[]> } | null>(null);

  const carregar = useCallback((force = false): Promise<BusinessUnit[]> => {
    const actor = eu.id;
    if (actor !== actorAtual.current) return Promise.resolve([]);
    if (actorDono.current !== actor) {
      actorDono.current = actor;
      generation.current += 1;
      request.current = null;
      setBus([]);
      setErro(null);
    }
    if (request.current?.actorId === actor && !force) return request.current.promise;
    if (force) generation.current += 1;
    const startedAt = generation.current;
    const pending = api.get<{ businessUnits: BusinessUnit[] }>('/business-units')
      .then((result) => {
        if (generation.current === startedAt && actor === actorAtual.current) { setBus(result.businessUnits); setErro(null); }
        return result.businessUnits;
      })
      .catch((error: unknown) => { ignorarSessaoMorta(error); if (generation.current === startedAt && actor === actorAtual.current) setErro('Não foi possível atualizar a lista de números.'); return []; })
      .finally(() => { if (request.current?.promise === pending) request.current = null; });
    request.current = { actorId: actor, promise: pending };
    return pending;
  }, [eu.id]);
  const atualizarCanais = useCallback(() => { void carregar(true); }, [carregar]);
  const visibleBus = actorDono.current === eu.id ? bus : [];
  const visibleError = actorDono.current === eu.id ? erro : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    void carregar();
    const timer = window.setInterval(() => { void carregar(); }, 5000);
    return () => { generation.current += 1; window.clearInterval(timer); };
  }, [carregar]);

  return <div className="grade">
    <h2 style={{ margin: 0 }}>Canais e números</h2>
    {visibleError && <p className="erro" role="status">{visibleError}</p>}
    <CadastroNumero eu={eu} bus={visibleBus} aoAtualizar={carregar} hideInstagramChannels />
    {visibleBus.map((bu) => (
      <div key={bu.id} className="cartao grade">
        <div className="linha">
          <strong>{bu.name}</strong>
          <span className="suave">Seu papel nesta BU: {bu.papel ?? 'sem acesso administrativo'}</span>
        </div>
        <InstagramConnections key={`${eu.id}:${bu.id}`} bu={bu} podeAdministrar={bu.papel === 'ADMIN' || bu.papel === 'OWNER'} onChanged={atualizarCanais} />
      </div>
    ))}
    {visibleBus.length === 0 && !visibleError && <p className="suave">Nenhum número no seu escopo.</p>}
  </div>;
}
```

```
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
TARGET="${1:-all}"
if (($# > 1)); then
  printf 'Usage: %s [api|api-instagram|web|browser|all]\n' "$0" >&2
  exit 2
fi
case "$TARGET" in
  api|api-instagram|web|browser|all) ;;
  *) printf 'Usage: %s [api|api-instagram|web|browser|all]\n' "$0" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

CHANNELS_DOCKER_TRANSPORT="${CHANNELS_DOCKER_TRANSPORT:-windows}"
case "$CHANNELS_DOCKER_TRANSPORT" in
  windows)
    command -v docker.exe >/dev/null || { echo 'Windows Docker CLI (docker.exe) is required.' >&2; exit 1; }
    command -v wslpath >/dev/null || { echo 'wslpath is required to bind the principal checkout.' >&2; exit 1; }
    DOCKER=(docker.exe)
    host_path() { wslpath -w "$1"; }
    bind_host_path() { wslpath -w "$1"; }
    ;;
  linux)
    command -v docker >/dev/null || { echo 'Linux Docker CLI (docker) is required for the linux transport.' >&2; exit 1; }
    DOCKER=(docker)
    host_path() { printf '%s' "$1"; }
    bind_host_path() {
      local path="$1"
      if [[ -n "${WSL_DISTRO_NAME:-}" ]]; then
        if [[ "${DOCKER_HOST:-}" != "unix:///mnt/wsl/docker-desktop/shared-sockets/guest-services/docker.sock" ]]; then
          echo 'WSL Linux transport requires the verified Docker Desktop shared socket.' >&2
          return 1
        fi
        if [[ "$path" =~ ^/mnt/([a-z])/(.+)$ ]]; then
          printf '/run/desktop/mnt/host/%s/%s' "${BASH_REMATCH[1]}" "${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
        else
          printf 'Unsupported WSL bind source path for Docker Desktop: %s\n' "$path" >&2
          return 1
        fi
      else
        printf '%s' "$path"
      fi
    }
    ;;
  *) printf 'Unsupported CHANNELS_DOCKER_TRANSPORT: %s\n' "$CHANNELS_DOCKER_TRANSPORT" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
CHANNELS_SOURCE_WINDOWS="$(bind_host_path "$ROOT_DIR")"
CHANNELS_EXPECTED_API_PACKAGE_SHA256="$(sha256sum "$ROOT_DIR/api-app/package.json" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"
CHANNELS_EXPECTED_WEB_PACKAGE_SHA256="$(sha256sum "$ROOT_DIR/web-app/package.json" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)"

# Keep host inputs as a positive inventory. Do not discover dotenv files with
# find/glob over either application tree: those trees can contain private
# configuration and local-only data. The exact public bind paths are listed
# below; only api-app/.env.example is mounted, while .env and .env.testing are
# supplied inside the validation container by the Compose config masks below.

cd "$ROOT_DIR"
temp_env="$(mktemp)"
temp_compose_overlay=""
```

```
class ContractError(Exception):

class StrictNoAliasLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
    def compose_node(self, parent: Any, index: Any) -> Any:
        if self.check_event(yaml.AliasEvent):
            raise ContractError("YAML aliases are not accepted")
        return super().compose_node(parent, index)

    def construct_mapping(self, node: yaml.MappingNode, deep: bool = False) -> dict[Any, Any]:
        if not isinstance(node, yaml.MappingNode):
            raise ContractError("expected YAML mapping")
        mapping: dict[Any, Any] = {}
        for key_node, value_node in node.value:
            key = self.construct_object(key_node, deep=deep)
            if key in mapping:
                raise ContractError(f"duplicate YAML key: {key}")
            mapping[key] = self.construct_object(value_node, deep=deep)
        return mapping


def parse_workflow(source: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
    try:
        value = yaml.load(source, Loader=StrictNoAliasLoader)
    except ContractError:
        raise
    except yaml.YAMLError as exc:
        raise ContractError(f"invalid workflow YAML: {exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or not isinstance(value.get("jobs"), dict):
        raise ContractError("workflow jobs mapping missing")
    return value

            '"${DOCKER_HOST:-}" != "unix:///mnt/wsl/docker-desktop/shared-sockets/guest-services/docker.sock"' not in runner_source or
            'printf \'/run/desktop/mnt/host/%s/%s\'' not in runner_source or
            'CHANNELS_SOURCE_WINDOWS="$(bind_host_path "$ROOT_DIR")"' not in runner_source or
            '$(bind_host_path "$path")' not in runner_source or
            'COMPOSE+=(-f "$temp_compose_overlay")' not in runner_source):
        raise ContractError("WSL Docker Desktop bind path translation or its narrow gate drifted")
    for overlay_fragment in (
        "temp_compose_overlay=\"$(mktemp)\"",
        "validation_api_env_mask:",
        "validation_root_env_mask:",
        "validation_root_env_testing_mask:",
        'file: %s\\n' ,
        '"$(yaml_scalar "$CHANNELS_API_ENV_EXAMPLE_WINDOWS")"',
        '"$(yaml_scalar "$CHANNELS_ROOT_ENV_EXAMPLE_WINDOWS")"',
        'rm -f "$temp_env" "$temp_compose_overlay"',
    ):
        if overlay_fragment not in runner_source:
            raise ContractError("WSL dotenv-mask overlay mapping or cleanup drifted")
    if "Validation cleanup failed" not in runner_source or "trap 'exit 130' INT" not in runner_source or "trap 'exit 143' TERM" not in runner_source:
        raise ContractError("observable lifecycle cleanup or signal handling missing")


def parse_and_validate(workflow_text: str, runner_source: str) -> None:
    validate_contract(parse_workflow(workflow_text), runner_source)


def assert_mutation_rejected(name: str, workflow_text: str, runner_source: str, mutate: Any) -> None:
    workflow = parse_workflow(workflow_text)
    altered_workflow, altered_runner = mutate(copy.deepcopy(workflow), runner_source)
    try:
        validate_contract(altered_workflow, altered_runner)
    except ContractError:
        return
    raise AssertionError(f"drift mutation was accepted: {name}")


def fake_wrapper_checks(runner_path: Path) -> dict[str, Any]:
    results: dict[str, Any] = {"inventory_failures": {}, "empty_config_control": None, "collision_control": None, "mandatory_failure_cleanup": None}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="channels-parity-selftest-") as tmp:
        root = Path(tmp)
        fake_bin = root / "bin"
        fake_bin.mkdir()
        log_path = root / "docker-calls.jsonl"
        docker = fake_bin / "docker"
        docker.write_text("""#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json, os, sys
args = sys.argv[1:]
with open(os.environ['DOCKER_FAKE_LOG'], 'a', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
    stream.write(json.dumps(args) + '\\n')
joined = ' '.join(args)
if args[:2] == ['ps', '-a']:
    if os.environ.get('DOCKER_FAKE_FAIL') == 'ps': sys.exit(31)
    if os.environ.get('DOCKER_FAKE_COLLISION') == 'container': print('leadshug_channels_validation_existing')
elif args[:2] == ['volume', 'ls']:
    if os.environ.get('DOCKER_FAKE_FAIL') == 'volume': sys.exit(32)
    if os.environ.get('DOCKER_FAKE_COLLISION') == 'volume': print('leadshug_channels_validation_existing')
elif args[:2] == ['network', 'ls']:
    if os.environ.get('DOCKER_FAKE_FAIL') == 'network': sys.exit(33)
    if os.environ.get('DOCKER_FAKE_COLLISION') == 'network': print('leadshug_channels_validation_existing')
elif args and args[0] == 'compose':
    if ' config ' in f' {joined} ':
        expected_root = os.environ.get('DOCKER_FAKE_EXPECT_ROOT')
        if expected_root:
            env_files = [args[index + 1] for index, part in enumerate(args[:-1]) if part == '--env-file']
            values = {}
            if env_files:
                with open(env_files[-1], encoding='utf-8') as stream:
                    for line in stream:
                        key, separator, value = line.rstrip('\\n').partition('=')
                        if separator: values[key] = value
            root = values.get('CHANNELS_SOURCE_WINDOWS')
            dockerignore = values.get('CHANNELS_API_DOCKERIGNORE_WINDOWS')
            print('DOCKER_FAKE_BIND_MATCH=' + str(root == expected_root and dockerignore == expected_root + '/api-app/.dockerignore').lower())
            compose_files = [args[index + 1] for index, part in enumerate(args[:-1]) if part == '-f']
            expect_overlay = os.environ.get('DOCKER_FAKE_EXPECT_OVERLAY') == '1'
            overlay_match = False
            if expect_overlay and len(compose_files) == 3:
                overlay = compose_files[-1]
                contents = open(overlay, encoding='utf-8').read()
                expected_lines = [
                    '  validation_api_env_mask:\\n',
                    '    file: "' + expected_root + '/api-app/.env.example"\\n',
                    '  validation_root_env_mask:\\n',
                    '    file: "' + expected_root + '/.env.example"\\n',
                    '  validation_root_env_testing_mask:\\n',
                    '    file: "' + expected_root + '/.env.example"\\n',
                ]
                overlay_match = all(line in contents.splitlines(keepends=True) for line in expected_lines)
                print('DOCKER_FAKE_OVERLAY_PATH=' + overlay)
            elif not expect_overlay and len(compose_files) == 2:
                overlay_match = True
            print('DOCKER_FAKE_OVERLAY_MATCH=' + str(overlay_match).lower())
        sys.exit(0)
    if ' up ' in f' {joined} ':
        sys.exit(0)
    if ' down ' in f' {joined} ':
        sys.exit(0)
    if ' run ' in f' {joined} ':
        if os.environ.get('DOCKER_FAKE_FAIL_REQUIRED_LEAF') == '1':
            marker = args.index('sh')
            script = args[marker + 2]
            env = os.environ.copy()
            env['PATH'] = os.environ['DOCKER_FAKE_LEAF_BIN'] + os.pathsep + env.get('PATH', '')
            child = __import__('subprocess').run(['sh', '-ec', script, *args[marker + 3:]], env=env)
            sys.exit(child.returncode)
        sys.exit(91)
    sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(0)
""", encoding="utf-8")
        docker.chmod(0o755)
        leaf_bin = root / "leaf-bin"
        leaf_bin.mkdir()
        for command, body in {
            "node": "#!/bin/sh\necho v22.0.0\n",
            "apt-get": "#!/bin/sh\nexit 0\n",
            # The real RUNNER_SCRIPT reaches this mandatory guard after its
            # prerequisites; failing here proves errexit and EXIT cleanup.
            "python3": "#!/bin/sh\nexit 42\n",
        }.items():
            path = leaf_bin / command
            path.write_text(body, encoding="utf-8")
            path.chmod(0o755)

        def run_case(label: str, extra: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[subprocess.CompletedProcess[str], list[list[str]]]:
            log_path.unlink(missing_ok=True)
            env = os.environ.copy()
            env.pop("DOCKER_FAKE_FAIL", None)
            env.pop("DOCKER_FAKE_COLLISION", None)
            env.pop("WSL_DISTRO_NAME", None)
            env.pop("DOCKER_HOST", None)
            env.update({
                "PATH": f"{fake_bin}{os.pathsep}{env.get('PATH', '')}",
                "CHANNELS_DOCKER_TRANSPORT": "linux",
                "CHANNELS_CONFIG_ONLY": "1",
                "DOCKER_FAKE_LOG": str(log_path),
                "DOCKER_FAKE_LEAF_BIN": str(leaf_bin),
                **extra,
            })
            result = subprocess.run(["bash", str(runner_path), "all"], cwd=runner_path.parent.parent,
                                    env=env, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, timeout=30)
            calls = [json.loads(line) for line in log_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()] if log_path.exists() else []
            return result, calls

        for failure in ("ps", "volume", "network"):
            result, calls = run_case(f"fail-{failure}", {"DOCKER_FAKE_FAIL": failure})
            compose_calls = [call for call in calls if call and call[0] == "compose"]
            if result.returncode == 0 or compose_calls:
                raise AssertionError(f"failed {failure} inventory reached Compose or succeeded: {result.stdout[-1000:]}")
            expected = {"ps": 1, "volume": 2, "network": 3}[failure]
            if len(calls) != expected:
                raise AssertionError(f"failed {failure} inventory did not stop immediately: {calls}")
            results["inventory_failures"][failure] = {"exit_code": result.returncode, "docker_calls": len(calls), "compose_calls": len(compose_calls)}

        result, calls = run_case("empty-config", {})
        compose_calls = [call for call in calls if call and call[0] == "compose"]
        if result.returncode != 0 or len(compose_calls) != 1 or not any("config" in call for call in compose_calls):
            raise AssertionError(f"empty namespace did not reach config-only control: {result.stdout[-1000:]}")
        if any(any(word in call for word in ("run", "up", "down")) for call in compose_calls):
            raise AssertionError(f"config-only control mutated resources: {compose_calls}")
        results["empty_config_control"] = {"exit_code": result.returncode, "compose_calls": compose_calls}

        checkout = runner_path.parent.parent.resolve().as_posix()
        native_root = checkout
        result, calls = run_case("native-path-control", {"DOCKER_FAKE_EXPECT_ROOT": native_root})
        if result.returncode != 0 or "DOCKER_FAKE_BIND_MATCH=true" not in result.stdout or "DOCKER_FAKE_OVERLAY_MATCH=true" not in result.stdout:
            raise AssertionError(f"native Linux bind paths changed unexpectedly: {result.stdout[-1000:]}")
        results["native_path_control"] = {"exit_code": result.returncode, "posix_bind_paths_preserved": True, "overlay_added": False}

        parts = checkout.split("/", 3)
        if len(parts) == 4 and parts[1] == "mnt" and len(parts[2]) == 1 and parts[2].islower():
            desktop_root = "/run/desktop/mnt/host/" + parts[2] + "/" + parts[3]
            result, calls = run_case("wsl-path-adapter", {
                "DOCKER_FAKE_EXPECT_ROOT": desktop_root,
                "DOCKER_FAKE_EXPECT_OVERLAY": "1",
                "WSL_DISTRO_NAME": "Ubuntu",
                "DOCKER_HOST": WSL_SHARED_SOCKET,
            })
            if result.returncode != 0 or "DOCKER_FAKE_BIND_MATCH=true" not in result.stdout or "DOCKER_FAKE_OVERLAY_MATCH=true" not in result.stdout:
                raise AssertionError(f"WSL Docker Desktop bind/mask overlay was not faithful: {result.stdout[-1000:]}")
            overlay_marker = next((line.split("=", 1)[1] for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.startswith("DOCKER_FAKE_OVERLAY_PATH=")), None)
            if not overlay_marker or Path(overlay_marker).exists():
                raise AssertionError("ephemeral WSL Compose overlay was not removed after the runner exited")
            results["wsl_bind_path_control"] = {"exit_code": result.returncode, "same_checkout_suffix": True, "dotenv_masks_same_public_sources": True, "overlay_removed_after_exit": True}
        else:
            results["wsl_bind_path_control"] = {"skipped": "self-test checkout is not on a WSL-mounted drive"}

        result, calls = run_case("unsupported-wsl-socket", {
            "WSL_DISTRO_NAME": "Ubuntu", "DOCKER_HOST": "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"})
        if result.returncode == 0 or calls:
            raise AssertionError("unsupported WSL Docker socket was not rejected before CLI use")
        results["unsupported_wsl_socket_control"] = {"exit_code": result.returncode, "docker_calls": len(calls)}

        result, calls = run_case("collision", {"DOCKER_FAKE_COLLISION": "container"})
        compose_calls = [call for call in calls if call and call[0] == "compose"]
        if result.returncode == 0 or compose_calls:
            raise AssertionError(f"collision control reached Compose: {result.stdout[-1000:]}")
        results["collision_control"] = {"exit_code": result.returncode, "compose_calls": len(compose_calls)}

        result, calls = run_case("mandatory-leaf-failure", {
            "CHANNELS_CONFIG_ONLY": "0",
            "DOCKER_FAKE_FAIL_REQUIRED_LEAF": "1",
        })
        lifecycle = [call for call in calls if call and call[0] == "compose" and any(part in call for part in ("run", "down"))]
        if result.returncode != 42 or not any("run" in call for call in lifecycle) or not any("down" in call for call in lifecycle):
            raise AssertionError(f"mandatory RUNNER_SCRIPT guard failure did not propagate through observable cleanup: exit={result.returncode}, lifecycle={lifecycle}, output={result.stdout[-1000:]}")
        results["mandatory_failure_cleanup"] = {
            "exit_code": result.returncode,
            "required_leaf": "fake python3 reached through actual RUNNER_SCRIPT and returned 42",
            "compose_lifecycle": ["run", "down"],
            "cleanup_observed": True,
            "provider_or_real_docker_invoked": False,
        }
    return results


def self_test() -> None:
    workflow_text = WORKFLOW_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    runner_source = RUNNER_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    parse_and_validate(workflow_text, runner_source)

    for malformed in ("jobs:\n  a: 1\n  a: 2\n", "jobs: &jobs\n  a: {}\ncopy: *jobs\n"):
        try:
            parse_workflow(malformed)
        except ContractError:
            continue
        raise AssertionError("duplicate-key or YAML-alias control was accepted")

    def workflow_mutation(action: Any) -> Any:
        def apply(workflow: dict[str, Any], runner: str) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], str]:
            altered = action(workflow, runner)
            return altered if isinstance(altered, tuple) else (workflow, runner)
        return apply

    mutations = {
        "missing-pr-trigger": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, _: (workflow.pop("on", None), workflow.pop(True, None), workflow)[-1]),
        "missing-channels-job": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, _: workflow["jobs"].pop("channels-validation")),
        "missing-retained-guard": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, _: workflow["jobs"]["compose"].__setitem__("steps", [step for step in workflow["jobs"]["compose"]["steps"] if step.get("name") != "Check channel suite admission"])),
        "weakened-job-gate": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, _: workflow["jobs"]["channels-validation"].__setitem__("if", "always()")),
        "swallowed-job-errors": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, _: workflow["jobs"]["channels-validation"]["steps"][1].__setitem__("continue-on-error", True)),
        "skipped-validate-step": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, _: next(step for step in workflow["jobs"]["channels-validation"]["steps"] if step.get("name") == "Validate channel suite and lifecycle").__setitem__("if", "${{ false }}")),
        "swallowed-retained-job": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, _: workflow["jobs"]["compose"].__setitem__("continue-on-error", True)),
        "skipped-retained-admission": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, _: next(step for step in workflow["jobs"]["compose"]["steps"] if step.get("name") == "Check channel suite admission").__setitem__("if", "${{ false }}")),
        "missing-retained-private-checkout": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, _: next(step for step in workflow["jobs"]["compose"]["steps"] if step.get("name") == "Checkout private channel validation sources").__setitem__("run", "true")),
        "missing-common-guard": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace(COMMON_GUARD, ""))),
        "swallowed-common-guard-failure": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace(COMMON_GUARD, COMMON_GUARD + " || true"))),
        "missing-instagram-selector": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("npm run test:e2e -- test/instagram*.e2e-spec.ts", "echo skipped"))),
        "widened-instagram-selector": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("test/instagram*.e2e-spec.ts", "test/*.e2e-spec.ts"))),
        "extra-runner-arguments-accepted": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace('if (($# > 1)); then', 'if false; then'))),
        "missing-e2e": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("npm run test:e2e", "echo skipped"))),
        "swallowed-e2e-failure": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("npm run test:e2e", "npm run test:e2e || true"))),
        "missing-browser": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("npm run test:tela -- --trace off", "echo skipped"))),
        "missing-migrate": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("npm run prisma:migrate", "echo skipped"))),
        "missing-generate": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("npm run prisma:generate", "echo skipped"))),
        "missing-lint": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("npm run lint", "echo skipped"))),
        "reordered-suite": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("npm run test:e2e", "TEMP").replace("npm run build", "npm run test:e2e").replace("TEMP", "npm run build"))),
        "missing-shell-guard": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("capture_inventory", "inventory_capture"))),
        "widened-wsl-socket": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace(WSL_SHARED_SOCKET, "unix:///var/run/docker.sock"))),
        "changed-wsl-host-prefix": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace("/run/desktop/mnt/host/%s/%s", "/run/desktop/other/%s/%s"))),
        "wrong-wsl-mask-source": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace('"$(yaml_scalar "$CHANNELS_API_ENV_EXAMPLE_WINDOWS")"', '"$(yaml_scalar "$CHANNELS_ROOT_ENV_EXAMPLE_WINDOWS")"'))),
        "missing-wsl-overlay": workflow_mutation(lambda workflow, runner: (workflow, runner.replace('COMPOSE+=(-f "$temp_compose_overlay")', "# overlay removed"))),
    }
    for name, mutation in mutations.items():
        assert_mutation_rejected(name, workflow_text, runner_source, mutation)

    fake_results = fake_wrapper_checks(RUNNER_PATH)
    print(json.dumps({"guard": "channels-ci-parity-v1", "yaml": "safe-no-alias-no-duplicates", "mutations_rejected": list(mutations), "outer_wrapper": fake_results}, sort_keys=True))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if sys.argv[1:] != ["--self-test"]:
        print("Usage: python3 scripts/check-channels-ci-parity.py --self-test", file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(2)
    self_test()
```

```
name: Verify workspace

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  compose:
    name: Validate Compose
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Checkout private channel validation sources
        env:
          SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          test -n "$SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN" || {
            echo "SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN must read the private LeadsHug submodules." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"
          git submodule sync -- api-app web-app
          git submodule update --init --depth=1 api-app web-app
      - name: Check channel suite admission
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update -qq
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3-yaml
          python3 scripts/check-channels-ci-parity.py --self-test
      - name: Validate the runtime topology
        env:
          SESSION_SECRET: ci-session-secret
          INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN: ci-internal-token
          WHATSAPP_TOKEN: ci-whatsapp-token
        run: docker compose config --quiet

  channels-validation:
    name: Channels PostgreSQL and browser
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.head_ref != 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Checkout private channel validation sources
        env:
          SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          test -n "$SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN" || exit 1
          git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"
          git submodule sync -- api-app web-app
          git submodule update --init --depth=1 api-app web-app
      - name: Validate channel suite and lifecycle
        env:
          CHANNELS_DOCKER_TRANSPORT: linux
        run: bash scripts/test-channels-local.sh all

  api:
    name: API
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Checkout the private API submodule
        env:
          SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          test -n "$SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN" || {
            echo "SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN must read the private LeadsHug submodules." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"
          git submodule sync -- api-app
          git submodule update --init --depth=1 api-app
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: api-app/package-lock.json
      - name: Install, lint, build, and test API
        working-directory: api-app
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run lint
          npm run build
          npm test

  web:
    name: Web
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Checkout the private Web submodule
        env:
          SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          test -n "$SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN" || {
            echo "SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN must read the private LeadsHug submodules." >&2
            exit 1
          }
          git config --global url."https://x-access-token:${SUBMODULES_REPO_TOKEN}@github.com/".insteadOf "https://github.com/"
          git submodule sync -- web-app
          git submodule update --init --depth=1 web-app
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web-app/package-lock.json
      - name: Install, build, and test Web
        working-directory: web-app
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
          npm test
```

```
services:

    labels:
      com.leadshug.channels.owner: number-onboarding

  api:

    environment:

  evolution:

    profiles: [channels-local]
    depends_on:
      evolution-postgres:

      evolution-redis:
        condition: service_healthy

      DATABASE_CONNECTION_CLIENT_NAME: leadshug_channels_local
      DATABASE_SAVE_DATA_INSTANCE: "true"

      DATABASE_SAVE_MESSAGE_UPDATE: "true"

      CACHE_REDIS_ENABLED: "true"

      CACHE_REDIS_PREFIX_KEY: leadshug_channels_local
      CACHE_REDIS_SAVE_INSTANCES: "true"
      CACHE_LOCAL_ENABLED: "false"
      LOG_LEVEL: ${EVOLUTION_LOG_LEVEL:-ERROR,WARN}
      LOG_COLOR: "false"
    volumes:
      - evolution_instances:/evolution/instances
    expose:
      - "8080"
    labels:
      com.leadshug.channels.owner: number-onboarding
    restart: unless-stopped

  evolution-header-probe:
    image: node:22.23.3-bookworm-slim
    profiles: [channels-probe]
    entrypoint: ["node", "-e"]
    command:
      - |
        const http = require('node:http');
        const { randomUUID } = require('node:crypto');
        const os = require('node:os');
        const port = 8091;
        const receiverIp = Object.values(os.networkInterfaces()).flat().find(address => address && address.family === 'IPv4' && !address.internal)?.address;
        let callbacks = [];
        const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
          const chunks = [];
          let bytes = 0;
          req.on('data', chunk => { bytes += chunk.length; if (bytes <= 1048576) chunks.push(chunk); });
          req.on('end', () => {
            const headerMatches = req.headers['x-leadshug-webhook-secret'] === process.env.PROBE_EXPECTED_HEADER;
            let event = 'other';
            try {
              const parsed = JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8'));
              event = typeof parsed.event === 'string' ? parsed.event.toLowerCase() : 'other';
            } catch {}
            const status = headerMatches ? 200 : 403;
            callbacks.push({ headerMatches, event, status });
            console.log(JSON.stringify({ method: req.method, path: req.url === '/probe-callback' ? '/probe-callback' : 'other', event, headerMatches, status }));
            res.writeHead(status).end();
          });
        });
        server.listen(port, '0.0.0.0', async () => {
          const base = 'http://evolution:8080';
          const headers = { 'content-type': 'application/json', apikey: process.env.EVOLUTION_AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY };
          const makeProbe = async (wrong) => {
            const name = 'leadshug-cp17-' + randomUUID();
            const expected = process.env.PROBE_EXPECTED_HEADER;
            const response = await fetch(base + '/instance/create', {
              method: 'POST', headers,
              body: JSON.stringify({ instanceName: name, integration: 'WHATSAPP-BAILEYS', qrcode: false,
                webhook: { enabled: true, events: ['INSTANCE_CREATE'], url: 'http://' + receiverIp + ':8091/probe-callback', headers: { 'x-leadshug-webhook-secret': wrong ? 'deliberately-wrong' : expected }, byEvents: false, base64: false } })
            });
            await response.arrayBuffer();
            const wanted = !wrong;
            const until = Date.now() + 15000;
            while (Date.now() < until && !callbacks.some(c => c.headerMatches === wanted && c.event === 'instance.create')) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));
            const received = callbacks.find(c => c.headerMatches === wanted && c.event === 'instance.create');
            let instanceObservedBeforeDelete = false;
            try {
              const listed = await fetch(base + '/instance/fetchInstances', { headers: { apikey: process.env.EVOLUTION_AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2000) });
              const instances = listed.ok ? await listed.json() : null;
              instanceObservedBeforeDelete = Array.isArray(instances) && instances.some(instance => instance?.instance?.instanceName === name || instance?.instanceName === name || instance?.name === name);
            } catch {}
            const del = await fetch(base + '/instance/delete/' + encodeURIComponent(name), { method: 'DELETE', headers, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) });
            await del.arrayBuffer();
            let removed = false;
            const cleanupUntil = Date.now() + 10000;
            while (Date.now() < cleanupUntil) {
              try {
                const listed = await fetch(base + '/instance/fetchInstances', { headers: { apikey: process.env.EVOLUTION_AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(2000) });
                if (!listed.ok) throw new Error('list_failed');
                const instances = await listed.json();
                if (!Array.isArray(instances)) throw new Error('invalid_list');
                const stillPresent = instances.some(instance => instance?.instance?.instanceName === name || instance?.instanceName === name || instance?.name === name);
                if (!stillPresent) { removed = true; break; }
              } catch {}
              await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250));
            }
            return { createStatus: response.status, callbackReceived: !!received, callbackStatusExpected: !!received && received.status === (wrong ? 403 : 200), instanceObservedBeforeDelete, deleteStatus: del.status, removed };
          };
          try {
            const correct = await makeProbe(false);
            callbacks = [];
            const wrong = await makeProbe(true);
            console.log(JSON.stringify({ correct, wrong }));
            if (correct.createStatus < 200 || correct.createStatus >= 300 || !correct.callbackReceived || !correct.callbackStatusExpected || !correct.instanceObservedBeforeDelete || correct.deleteStatus < 200 || correct.deleteStatus >= 300 || wrong.createStatus < 200 || wrong.createStatus >= 300 || !wrong.callbackReceived || !wrong.callbackStatusExpected || !wrong.instanceObservedBeforeDelete || wrong.deleteStatus < 200 || wrong.deleteStatus >= 300 || !correct.removed || !wrong.removed) process.exitCode = 1;
          } catch {
            console.log(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'probe_failed' }));
            process.exitCode = 1;
          } finally { server.close(); }
        });
    environment:
      EVOLUTION_AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY: ${EVOLUTION_AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY:?Set EVOLUTION_AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY in .env.testing}
      PROBE_EXPECTED_HEADER: leadshug-cp21-fictitious-provider-probe-header
    networks: [default]
    labels:
      com.leadshug.channels.owner: number-onboarding
    restart: "no"
```

## FULL SOURCE docker/local-gateway.conf.template

```
# This file is included from nginx's http context. Deliberately omit request
# target, query, headers and body from every gateway log.
map $uri $leadshug_route {
    default other;
    ~^/webhooks/meta/?$ meta;
}
log_format leadshug_safe '$time_iso8601 route=$leadshug_route method=$request_method status=$status bytes=$bytes_sent request_time=$request_time upstream_status=$upstream_status upstream_time=$upstream_response_time';
# Disable the base nginx image's inherited main format, which includes $request.
# The server below installs the redacted access format explicitly.
access_log off;
error_log /dev/null emerg;
map $http_x_forwarded_proto $leadshug_forwarded_proto {
    "~^(https?)$" $http_x_forwarded_proto;
    default $scheme;
}

server {
    listen 80;
    server_name _;
    access_log /dev/stdout leadshug_safe;
    # API upload ceiling is 1 MiB; leave room for multipart framing.
    client_max_body_size 2m;

    proxy_http_version 1.1;
    proxy_set_header Host $host;
    proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $leadshug_forwarded_proto;
    proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Host $host;
    proxy_connect_timeout 10s;
    proxy_send_timeout 120s;
    proxy_read_timeout 120s;

    location = /health {
        proxy_pass http://api:3000;
    }

    location = /ws {
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";
        proxy_read_timeout 1h;
        proxy_pass http://api:3000;
    }

    location = /api {
        proxy_pass http://api:3000;
    }

    location ^~ /api/ {
        proxy_pass http://api:3000;
    }

    location ^~ /webhooks/ {
        proxy_pass http://api:3000;
    }

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://web:80;
    }
}
```

```
# Shared defaults for the generic local stack. The isolated channel runtime
# writes its own ignored .env.testing file; never copy private values here.
POSTGRES_DB=leadshug_channels_local
POSTGRES_USER=leadshug
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=
POSTGRES_HOST_PORT=55433

API_HOST_PORT=3000
WEB_HOST_PORT=8080
WEB_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8080
LEADSHUG_API_URL=

# The channel gateway is the only host-published service in the isolated stack.
CHANNELS_GATEWAY_HOST_PORT=8083
CHANNELS_LOCAL_ORIGIN=http://localhost:8083

# Required API/session secrets. Generate only in ignored .env.testing.
SESSION_SECRET=
INTERNAL_SERVICE_TOKEN=

# Meta is intentionally all absent until the complete private configuration
# and a verified HTTPS origin are available. Do not add real IDs here.
META_APP_ID=
META_APP_SECRET=
META_SIGNUP_CONFIG_ID=
GRAPH_VERSION=
PUBLIC_ORIGIN=
WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN=
CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY_ID=
CHANNEL_CREDENTIAL_KEY=

# Operator Evolution instance. Channel capability stays disabled until its
# public callback URL is known and the provider log/header probes pass.
LH_CHANNEL_UNOFFICIAL=false
EVOLUTION_API_URL=http://evolution:8080
EVOLUTION_API_KEY=
EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_URL=
EVOLUTION_WEBHOOK_SECRET=
EVOLUTION_AUTHENTICATION_API_KEY=

EVOLUTION_POSTGRES_USER=evolution
EVOLUTION_POSTGRES_PASSWORD=
EVOLUTION_LOG_LEVEL=ERROR,WARN

# Optional server-side Typebot configuration.

TYPEBOT_WORKSPACE_ID=
```

```
import { BadRequestException, Body, ConflictException, Controller, Get, HttpCode, NotFoundException, Param, Post, Query, Req, Res } from '@nestjs/common';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { AccessService } from '../../domain/access/access.service';
import { exigirPapelNaBu } from '../../domain/access/require-role';
import { ConversationsService } from '../../domain/inbox/conversations.service';
import { RegistroDeAtividade } from '../../domain/historico/registro.service';
import { ator } from './setores.controller';
import { validarConsultaTimeline } from '../../domain/inbox/timeline-pagination';
import { ConversationStartService } from '../../domain/inbox/conversation-start.service';
import { InitialMessageService, type InitialMessagePreviewRequest, type InitialMessageRequest } from '../../domain/inbox/initial-message.service';
import { SessionService } from '../../infra/session/session.service';
import type { Prisma } from '@prisma/client';
import { PrismaService } from '../../infra/prisma/prisma.service';

const ABAS = ['QUEUED', 'IN_SERVICE', 'CLOSED'] as const;

/** A inbox por BU (ADR-0009): uma tela para os dois canais. */
@Controller('api/bff')
export class ConversationsController {
  constructor(
    private readonly access: AccessService,
    private readonly conversas: ConversationsService,
    private readonly registro: RegistroDeAtividade,
    private readonly conversationStart: ConversationStartService,
    private readonly initialMessages: InitialMessageService,
    private readonly sessions: SessionService,
    private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
  ) {}

  @Post('business-units/:buId/conversations/open')
  @HttpCode(200)
  async abrirPorContato(
    @Param('buId') buId: string,
    @Body() body: { telefone?: unknown },
    @Req() req: Request,
    @Res({ passthrough: true }) response: Response,
  ) {
    await exigirPapelNaBu(this.access, req.usuario!.id, buId, 'ATENDENTE');
    await this.assertActorTenant(req, buId);
    if (!body || typeof body !== 'object' || Object.keys(body).some((key) => key !== 'telefone')
      || typeof body.telefone !== 'string') {
      throw new BadRequestException({ code: 'REQUISICAO_INVALIDA' });
    }
    const result = await this.conversationStart.start(buId, body.telefone);
    if (result.created) {
      await this.registro.registrarSolto(req.usuario!.mantenedoraId, 'atendimento.conversa.aberta', ator(req), {
        buId,
        entidadeId: result.conversation.id,
        frase: { contato: result.conversation.contact },
      });
    }
    response.status(result.created ? 201 : 200);
    return {
      conversaId: result.conversation.id,
      criada: result.created,
      contact: result.conversation.contact,
    };
  }

  @Get('conversations/:id/start-options')
  async startOptions(@Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);
    await this.assertActorTenant(req, conversa.buId);
    return this.initialMessages.options({ conversationId: conversa.id, buId: conversa.buId });
  }

  @Get('conversations/:id/reply-options')
  async replyOptions(@Param('id') id: string, @Req() req: Request) {

    await this.assertActorTenant(req, conversa.buId);
    return this.conversas.replyOptions(conversa.id, conversa.buId);
  }

  @Post('conversations/:id/initial-message-preview')
  @HttpCode(200)
  async initialPreview(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);
    await this.assertActorTenant(req, conversa.buId);
    const message = this.initialMessageRequest(body, false);
    return this.initialMessages.preview({ conversationId: conversa.id, buId: conversa.buId, actorId: req.usuario!.id, message });
  }

  @Post('conversations/:id/initial-messages')
  async initialSend(@Param('id') id: string, @Body() body: Record<string, unknown>, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) response: Response) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);
    await this.assertActorTenant(req, conversa.buId);
    const key = req.header('Idempotency-Key') ?? '';
    const message = this.initialMessageRequest(body, true);
    const result = await this.initialMessages.submit({
      conversationId: conversa.id, buId: conversa.buId, actorId: req.usuario!.id, actorName: req.usuario!.nome,
      idempotencyKey: key, message,
      validateActorInTransaction: (tx) => this.currentActorHasGrant(req, conversa.buId, tx),
      actorDispatchFence: this.actorDispatchFence(req, conversa.buId),
    });
    const { expiredPrepared, ...safeResult } = result;
    const active = ['SENDING', 'EXTERNAL_ACCEPTED'].includes(result.attempt.state)
      || result.attempt.state === 'PREPARED' && !expiredPrepared;
    response.status(result.expiredPrepared ? 409 : active ? 202 : result.replay ? 200 : result.attempt.state === 'SUCCEEDED' ? 201 : 409);
    return expiredPrepared ? { ...safeResult, code: 'INITIAL_ATTEMPT_EXPIRED' } : safeResult;
  }

  @Get('conversations/:id/initial-messages/:attemptId')
  async initialAttempt(@Param('id') id: string, @Param('attemptId') attemptId: string, @Req() req: Request) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);
    await this.assertActorTenant(req, conversa.buId);
    this.assertUuid(attemptId);
    return this.initialMessages.getAttempt({ id: attemptId, conversationId: conversa.id, buId: conversa.buId });
  }

  @Post('conversations/:id/initial-messages/:attemptId/reconcile')
  @HttpCode(200)
  async reconcileInitial(@Param('id') id: string, @Param('attemptId') attemptId: string, @Body() body: unknown, @Req() req: Request, @Res({ passthrough: true }) response: Response) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);
    await this.assertActorTenant(req, conversa.buId);
    this.assertEmptyBody(body);
    this.assertUuid(attemptId);
    const result = await this.initialMessages.reconcile({ id: attemptId, conversationId: conversa.id, buId: conversa.buId,
      actorId: req.usuario!.id, actorName: req.usuario!.nome,
      validateActorInTransaction: (tx) => this.currentActorHasGrant(req, conversa.buId, tx) });
    if (['PREPARED', 'SENDING'].includes(result.state)) response.status(202);
    return result;
  }

  @Post('conversations/:id/initial-messages/:attemptId/acknowledge')
  @HttpCode(200)
  async acknowledgeInitial(@Param('id') id: string, @Param('attemptId') attemptId: string, @Body() body: unknown, @Req() req: Request) {
    const { conversa } = await this.resolver(id, req);
    await this.assertActorTenant(req, conversa.buId);
    this.assertEmptyBody(body);
    this.assertUuid(attemptId);
    return this.initialMessages.acknowledge({ id: attemptId, conversationId: conversa.id, buId: conversa.buId, actorId: req.usuario!.id,
      confirmed: req.header('X-Confirm-Duplication-Risk') === 'true', validateActorInTransaction: (tx) => this.currentActorHasGrant(req, conversa.buId, tx),
      auditInTransaction: (tx) => this.registro.registrar(tx, req.usuario!.mantenedoraId, 'atendimento.initial.risk_acknowledged', ator(req), { buId: conversa.buId, entidadeId: attemptId }) });
  }

  @Post('conversations/:id/dispatch-admissions/:admissionId/reconcile')

      validateActorInTransaction: (tx) => this.currentActorHasGrant(req, conversa.buId, tx) });

  @Post('conversations/:id/dispatch-admissions/:admissionId/acknowledge')
```
